### IV. The Discovery-to-Canon Funnel: How Thematic Attractors Are Born

Because deterministic compilers cannot manufacture original human stakes from an empty schema, Thematic Attractors are never invented inside the production pipeline (Phases 1–7); they are discovered inductively across the **Discovery vs. Production Boundary (Phase 0 / Step 0)** and promoted through a strict sovereign seam:

```text
[1. DUMPSTER VAULT INGESTION]  ──►  Unstructured Slack drops (#writers-room) & 
    (Tier 1 & Tier 2 Vault)         Axis B diffusion hallucinations (S ≥ 0.70)
                                                       │
                                                       ▼
[2. MULTI-MODAL HDBSCAN]       ──►  !ResearchDigest computes V_joint = α·V_text ⊕ β·V_vis
    (Tier 3 Clustering)             Synthesizes recurring motifs against 01.canon
                                                       │
                                                       ▼
[3. STEP 0 DIVERGENCE FAN-OUT] ──►  4-Model Scatter-Gather (Sonnet, Qwen, Inversion, 8B)
    (DivergenceTriagePanel.tsx)     Backward-induces: TRIGGER ──► REFUSAL ──► COST
                                                       │
                                                       ▼
[4. FORMAL PROPOSAL GATE]      ──►  !PitchGrievance compiles DAG edges, 2d6 bounds,
    (Tier 4 Ratification)           and seals the new Attractor into bible-state.json

```

1. **Multi-Modal Thematic Clustering (`!ResearchDigest`):**
To prevent raw creative notes in `vault/ingest/` from rotting in the **"Dumpster Vault"**, Tier 3 executes weekly (`0 0 * * 1`) or on-demand (`!ResearchDigest <topic>`) clustering sweeps. It embeds prose notes via `text-embedding-3-small` ($1{,}536\text{-d}$) and visual references via `DINOv2 / SigLIP` ($768\text{-d}$) into a concatenated joint vector:



$$V_{\text{joint}} = \alpha \cdot V_{\text{text}} \oplus \beta \cdot V_{\text{vis}}$$



Using **HDBSCAN**, it clusters isolated fragments into load-bearing thematic motifs and audits them against `01.canon`.


2. **Retro-Injection of Axis B Hallucinations (`harvest.astro`):**
When downstream diffusion models (Wan 2.2, Flux) or LLMs hallucinate unscripted details (e.g., a chipped green enamel cup on a crate), **Grounding DINO** and **Dependency AST** extractors evaluate their salience:



$$S = (0.4 \cdot \text{Recurrence}) + (0.6 \cdot \text{Drama})$$



Details scoring $S < 0.70$ are purged as Tier 1 ephemeral noise to prevent the **Accidental Canon Trap**. High-salience details ($S \ge 0.70$) are held behind a **Quarantine Fence** in `unratified_details.jsonl`, cross-queried against the **NotebookLM** research vault for dormant thematic resonance, and surfaced for one-click ratification into `01.canon`.


3. **Step 0 Multi-Model Divergence & Backward Rule Induction (`DivergenceTriagePanel.tsx`):**
To discover authentic character friction without suffering **Shared Latent Bias** or **"Lost-in-the-Middle" Attention Decay** (which causes models to regress toward the statistical median, or **The Beige Plague**, exploited by **The Pervert / Archetype 14**), the Step 0 harness packs World Axioms, Character Baselines, and Ensemble Impasse rules into the top 15% (primacy) and bottom 15% (recency) of the context window. It fans the premise across four heterogeneous configurations concurrently:


* **Take A (Psychological Subtext):** Claude 3.5 Sonnet ($T = 0.85$).


* **Take B (Concrete Physical Staging):** Qwen 2.5 32B ($T = 0.85$).


* **Take C (Structural Reversal):** Adversarial Inversion Prompt ($T = 0.90$).


* **Take D (Staccato Curtness):** Local 8B GGUF Specialist.
Once the showrunner selects a take containing genuine surprise, the **Post-Selection Extraction Pass** works backward from the dialogue to induce an immutable **Refusal Vector** ($\text{TRIGGER} \longrightarrow \text{MANDATORY REFUSAL} \longrightarrow \text{UNAVOIDABLE COST}$) and graduates the cluster via `!PitchGrievance <Entity_A> vs <Entity_B> <Premise>` into `CANON_DB`.

### V. Compile-Time Attractor Diagnostics & Failure Lockouts ($T_0 = \$0.00$)

A Thematic Attractor that is too weak leaves the story directionless; an Attractor that is too strong warps the storyworld into a single-point-of-failure bottleneck or relentless melodrama. Before a single serverless GPU second or TTS audio stem is purchased, the **Corpus Health, Taxonomy & Farce Boundary Tuner** (`src/pages/health/corpus.astro`) enforces four mathematical lockouts at **$T_0 = \$0.00$**:

1. **The Gini Coefficient of Canon ($G$) & Blast-Radius Control:**
If a Thematic Attractor anchors too many grievances and scenes to a single prop or room (creating **The Monolithic Spine**, where in-degree centrality $k_{\text{in}} \ge 15$), any minor retcon triggers a massive **Transitive Invalidation Blast Radius** ($R_{\text{blast}}(v) = \vert{}\mathcal{I}(v)\vert{}/n$) across dozens of rendered scenes. The compiler evaluates the Gini dispersion across all entities:



$$G = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sum_{j=1}^{n} \vert{}k_i - k_j\vert{}}{2n^2 \bar{k}}$$



It enforces a resilient **Balanced Ecosystem ($0.30 \le G \le 0.50$)** anchored by **Balanced Hubs ($5 \le k_{\text{in}} < \text{SpineLimit}$)**; if $G > 0.65$ (Monolithic Collapse), the cockpit engages a compile-time dispatch lockout.


2. **Categorical Equilibrium ($H_{\text{norm}}$):**
To prevent **Thematic Monotony & Cooldown Exhaustion**—where authors write 12 variations of food disputes that simultaneously enter cooldown ($C_{\text{cooldown}}$) and stall the Stage 3 conflict lottery—Pillar 2 audits the **Shannon Entropy ($H_{\text{norm}}$)** of grievance categories, blocking execution if any thematic channel is starved.


3. **The Tonal Override Ratio (The Farce Cap, $R_{\text{farce}}$):**
Because escalation-favoring 2d6 duel mechanics naturally pull every narrative arc toward maximum-intensity feuds (**Tone Drift & Melodramatic Runaway**), the compiler enforces strict config bounds ($\text{min\_farce} \le R_{\text{farce}} \le \text{max\_farce}$, e.g., $R_{\text{farce}} \le 0.15$). This guarantees that enough depth-0 **Clown** leaf nodes exist to vent pressure without allowing comedy to erode the season's core stakes.


4. **The MAYA Aesthetic Equilibrium:**
At the macro-design layer, the Attractor's modal distance from baseline reality is calibrated against Raymond Loewy’s **MAYA Principle (Most Advanced Yet Acceptable)**—balancing audience *neophilia* (hunger for strange, exotic atmospheric tension) against *neophobia* (cognitive rejection of an ungrounded, alien rulebook) by anchoring bizarre world axioms inside intensely recognizable domestic and interpersonal frictions.



Would you like to formalize the TypeScript schema for **The Prophet's Backward-DAG Eligibility Reducer** in `worker-sower-engine`, or design the **Vibe Monitor (`pressure_system`)** Durable Object state machine that computes the 1,536-d Centroid Vector and triggers `macro_axioms.json` overrides?

The **Reconciled Error Trajectory Calculus & 3-Cycle Circuit Breaker** is the self-healing governance, fault-containment, and escalation subsystem of the Generative Production Pipeline. Operating across `camp-candor/000.repo-bot`, `apps/worker/src/triage/circuitBreaker.ts`, and `apps/995.library/995.library/00.library.unit`, it prevents autonomous coding agents (Jules), generative infill passes, and human operators from entering infinite "fix-and-break" retry loops that burn compute budgets, mask impossible upstream contradictions, and introduce compounding hallucinations.

### 1. Economic Rationale & The Pre-Flight Error Taxonomy

#### A. The Step-Discontinuity of Irreversible Commitments ($T_0 \to T_5$)

Error arbitration is governed by the reality that defect remediation costs do not scale along a smooth curve; they jump across discrete, irreversible commitment cliffs:

$$\text{Cost}(t) = \sum_{i=0}^{5} \Delta C_i \cdot \mathbf{1}_{\{t \ge T_i\}}$$

* **$T_0$ (Pre-Flight AST & Static Schema Validation):** Costs $\$0.00$ and $0\text{ ms}$ of cloud compute.


* **$T_1 / T_2$ (Local Audio Synthesis & CPU Pre-Viz):** Costs pennies on local Rig 1 CPU/RAM ($0\text{ MB}$ GPU VRAM).


* **$T_3$ (Cloud GPU Diffusion):** Costs $\$0.05$ to $\$5.00$ per shot in serverless tensor compute.


* **$T_4$ (Human Editorial Conform):** Costs $\$50.00$ to $\$150.00$ per hour in manual NLE masking and conforming labor.


* **$T_5$ (Public Broadcast / Print Release):** Inflicts thousands of dollars in catastrophic canon and brand damage.



#### B. Why $N = 3$ Cycles Is the Architectural Invariant

The hard ceiling of $N = 3$ repair attempts is enforced across all studio pods for specific operational reasons:

* **Why not $N = 1$ or $N = 2$?** Two cycles represent normal variance in creative or technical execution; escalating earlier undermines pod autonomy and floods human architects with false alarms.


* **Why not $N \ge 5$?** Allowing five or six retries triggers **Silent Cost Absorption**, where craftspeople or automated agents quietly burn hours and GPU capital patching recurring symptoms, masking systemic toolchain flaws, prompt bugs, or broken rig geometry.



#### C. The Three-Class Failure Taxonomy (Pre-Gate Routing)

Before the 3-Cycle Circuit Breaker is even engaged, every intercepted pipeline anomaly is sorted into one of three distinct failure domains so deterministic bugs are never retried:

| Failure Class | Concrete Triggers | Pipeline Response & Retry Policy | Compute Cost Impact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **1. Deterministic Failures**<br> | Zod schema mismatch, capability UNSAT ($\text{ArmsRequired} > \text{ArmsAvailable}$), banned verb leak, verbatim parity breach, or missing asset.

 | **Immediate Fatal Halt (Exit Code 1).** Zero retries permitted because identical deterministic inputs produce identical failures.

 | **$\$0.00$**; halts at Stage $T_0$ before audio synthesis or GPU rendering begins.

 |
| **2. Stochastic Quality Failures**<br> | Flat dialogue, unearned subtext release, voice bleed, vocoder pop/click, dropped phoneme, or failed $-16\text{ LUFS}$ loudness gate.

 | **Bounded Retry ($N_{\max} = 2$ retries / 3 total attempts).** Re-runs with an altered PRNG seed or injected negative constraint; trips circuit breaker on 3rd failure.

 | **Negligible**; bounded to isolated local CPU passes or surgical MEU windows.

 |
| **3. Infrastructure Failures**<br> | Network timeout, CUDA OOM crash, dead headless browser worker, transient file lock contention, or `EPIPE` on socket.

 | **Idempotent Resume.** Resumes execution from the last verified content-addressed `.tmp` buffer using caller-generated `UUIDv7` idempotency keys.

 | **Zero state loss**; avoids re-burning upstream inference tokens.

 |

### 2. Resolving the Category Error: Reconciled Error Trajectory Calculus

#### A. The Error Signature Vector ($\vec{E}$)

Whenever an automated verification rung or invariant linter fails, `repo-bot` and Antigravity strip unstructured stack traces and extract a formal **Error Signature Vector**:

$$\vec{E} = \langle \text{Domain}, \, \text{TargetEntity}, \, \text{RuleID}, \, \text{OffendingTokens / FailingAssertion} \rangle$$

For example, if an agent drafts a scene where an injured character sprints, Attempt 1 yields $\vec{E}_1 = \langle \text{SOMATIC}, \, \text{char\_silas}, \, \text{UNSTEADY\_GAIT}, \, [\text{"sprint"}] \rangle$.

#### B. The Historical Category Error: Naïve Divergence vs. Progressive Unmasking

Early iterations of the studio architecture suffered from a foundational category error: **conflating Progressive Defect Unmasking with Mathematical Constraint Impossibility**.

* **The Flawed Naïve Rule:** Early designs assumed that any cross-domain jump between Attempt 1 and Attempt 2 ($\text{Domain}(\vec{E}_1) \neq \text{Domain}(\vec{E}_2)$)—such as fixing a somatic error (`sprint`) by having the character shout across the room, which then triggered an epistemic error (`secret_revealed`)—constituted mathematical proof that the underlying constraint space was mutually exclusive ($C_{\text{somatic}} \cap C_{\text{epistemic}} \cap C_{\text{logistical}} = \emptyset$), triggering a hard halt on Attempt 2.


* **Why That Was Wrong:** In sequential prose and code generation, fixing Defect $A$ frequently unmasks a pre-existing or secondary Defect $B$ simply because the second constraint was not yet salient in the local repair prompt. Furthermore, inferring mathematical unsatisfiability from stochastic LLM failures wastes compute tokens.



#### C. The Reconciled Triage Protocol

The reconciled architecture separates **Pre-Flight Satisfiability** from **Runtime Trajectory Calculus** through three strict laws:

1. **Direct Pre-Flight SAT Enforcement at $T_0 = \$0.00$:** True mathematical unsatisfiability (e.g., a scene setup requiring a character with zero free hands to operate a two-handed pump) is evaluated *directly over the constraint declarations* via an offline propositional SAT solver at $T_0 = \$0.00$ before any agent is dispatched.


2. **Tri-Modal Trajectory Arbitration ($[\vec{E}_0, \dots, \vec{E}_n]$):** During active repair cycles, the orchestrator inspects the sequence of error vectors across three distinct trajectory modes:



```text
                           VERIFICATION RUN FAILS
                                     │
                                     ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   INSPECT ERROR SIGNATURE TRAJECTORY                   │
│   Current Attempt: E_n   |   Previous Attempts: [E_0, ..., E_{n-1}]    │
└────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘
                                     │
       ┌─────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────┐
       ▼ OSCILLATION                 ▼ PROGRESSIVE UNMASKING       ▼ STAGNATION / CONVERGENCE
  [ E_n == E_{n-2} ]            [ New Invariant Class ]       [ Same Invariant Class ]
  • Alternating A -> B -> A     • Fixing A unmasked B         • Domain(E_1) == Domain(E_2)
  • Hard conflict confirmed     • DO NOT HALT on single jump  • E.g., 'sprint' -> 'dash' or
  • IMMEDIATE CIRCUIT TRIP      • Inject BOTH constraints       viseme drift 24px -> 6px
  • Wipe branch to S_clean        (R_A AND R_B) simultaneously • Inject amplified negative
  • Escalate to Architect       • Allow final attempt           prompt for Attempt 3

```

3. **Asset Integrity vs. Code Regression Demarcation:** On Axis B (Optical Compositing / `goblin-viewport-template`), the trajectory analyzer also resolves **Category Error #5 (Conflating Code Regressions with Asset Integrity Defects)**.


* **Converging `CODE_ERROR`:** If Attempt 2 fails within the same geometric domain with a shrinking numerical delta (e.g., mouth viseme offset drops from $24\text{px} \to 6\text{px}$ or $12\text{px} \to 3\text{px}$), Jules uses the TypeScript Compiler API (`ts-morph`) to mutate only the failing JSX attribute in place and verifies the fix over an isolated 24–48 frame window using headless CPU software rasterization (`--gl=swangle`) at $\$0.00$ GPU cost.


* **Divergent `ASSET_ERROR`:** If adjusting a React wrapper prop to fix mouth alignment introduces an alpha contour leak or safe-zone framing clip ($\text{Classification}_1 \neq \text{Classification}_2$), the system flags a `DIVERGENT_STRUCTURAL_CONFLICT` / `STRUCTURAL_ASSET_DEFECT`. The underlying sprite cutout or diffusion plate from POD-07/POD-15 is physically defective; the breaker halts immediately so Jules does not hack React layout code to mask broken art.

### 3. Anatomy of the 3-Cycle Escalation State Machine

Across all execution domains—narrative AST infill, TypeScript code repair, interactive lockfile editing, and cloud GPU container benchmarking—the 3-Cycle Escalation Rule enforces an identical four-stage progression:

| Stage | Execution Phase | Permitted Remediation Scope & System Mechanics |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Cycle 1** | **Primary Execution**<br> | Jules or the Scene Pod executes the full specification within an isolated VM, ephemeral Dynamic Worker (`<5\text{ ms}` JS / `<15\text{ ms}` Shell), or `computerd` FUSE container (`1\text{s}–3\text{s}`).

 |
| **Cycle 2** | **Localized Correction**<br> | Micro-adjustments only: localized syntax fixes, token substitution, `ts-morph` JSX coordinate deltas, or adjusting inpainting mask boundaries and ControlNet conditioning once.

 |
| **Cycle 3** | **Boundary Clamping**<br> | Final pass: strict compound constraint injection ($R_A \land R_B$), amplified negative token masks (`FORBIDDEN: ["sprint", "dash", "run"]`), prompt weight micro-adjustments, or PRNG seed variance.

 |
| **Breach** | **Hard Code Lock / Ontological Impasse**<br> | Instantaneous halt on Cycle 3 failure (or Cycle 2 structural divergence / oscillation). Task flips to `BLOCKED` (`Not Safely Certifiable`), `.tmp` scratchpads are unlinked, remote `spec/*` branch is obliterated or frozen as a Dead-Letter Trace, `#ESCALATED_REVISION_CEILING_BREACHED` is tagged, and a `DiagnosticEscalationDossier` is dispatched.

 |

### 4. Concrete Implementation Architectures & Type Contracts

The notebook sources define three complementary TypeScript implementations of the circuit breaker across the studio's execution layers:

#### A. Automated Tier 4 Drift Inspection Gauntlet (`apps/worker/src/triage/circuitBreaker.ts`)

Used by edge verification workers to arbitrate visual and structural drift across candidate commits (`candidateSha`):

* **Jurisprudence Severity Ranking:** Maps defects to monotonic integer ranks:
* `SEVERITY_1_NITPICK = 1`

* `SEVERITY_2_FRICTION = 2`

* `SEVERITY_3_VIOLATION = 3`

* `SEVERITY_4_HERESY = 4`



* **Trajectory Evaluation (`analyzeTrajectory`):** Compares `previous: CycleAttemptRecord` against `current: CycleAttemptRecord`. Returns `'DIVERGENCE'` if `previous.classification !== current.classification` (cross-category structural hopping) or if `SEVERITY_RANK[current.severity] > SEVERITY_RANK[previous.severity]` (severity escalation); otherwise returns `'CONVERGENCE'`.


* **Breaker Arbitration (`evaluateCircuitBreaker`):**
1. *Hard Ceiling (`attemptCount >= 3`):* Emits `action: 'CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIPPED'`, `shouldHalt: true`.


2. *Immediate Divergence Short-Circuit (`attemptCount >= 2 && trajectory === 'DIVERGENCE'`):* Emits `action: 'DIVERGENT_STRUCTURAL_CONFLICT'`, `shouldHalt: true`.


3. *Convergence Retry (`attemptCount < 3 && trajectory === 'CONVERGENCE'`):* Emits `action: 'ALLOW_CYCLE_RETRY'`, `shouldHalt: false`.





#### B. Interactive Three-Strike Human Gate (`apps/995.library/995.library/00.library.unit`)

Governs human-in-the-loop conflict resolution when an operator edits the sovereign coordination manifest (`data/versions.json`) in `$EDITOR` or reconciles a dirty scene draft (`scene_draft.tmp`):

* **The Three Post-Save Validation Gates:** Closing `$EDITOR` does not commit changes; the scratchpad (`data/lockfile/.tmp_versions_conflict_<nonce>.json`) must clear **Gate 1 (Zod Syntax & Schema)**, **Gate 2 (Git Object Reachability via `git cat-file -e <sha>` confirming 40-character hashes)**, and **Gate 3 (SAT Compatibility Solver verifying the additive Expand contract)**.


* **Strikes 1 & 2 (In-Place Annotation):** If any gate fails, the engine prepends plain-text diagnostic commentary directly to the top of the `.tmp` file, re-suspends the Blessed TUI runtime, and re-opens `$EDITOR`.


* **Strike 3 (Circuit Breaker Trip & 7-Bit ASCII Telemetry):** If Attempt 3 fails, the breaker trips (`escalation_event: 'LOCKFILE_HUMAN_GATE_BREAKER_TRIPPED'`), classifies the failure (`PERSISTENT_SCHEMA_VIOLATION` | `CAS_REACHABILITY_FAILURE` | `MONOTONIC_SAT_FAILURE` | `OPERATOR_ABORT`), immediately `unlink`s the `.tmp` scratchpad, preserves `data/versions.json` untouched, and streams the `CircuitBreakerDossier` to terminal pane `cns00` via `ActCns.UPDATE_CONSOLE` using strictly 7-bit pure ASCII tokens (`>>`, `[OK]`, `[FAIL]`, `::`, `---`) with zero UTF-8 emojis.


* **Atomic Promotion (On Pass):** Executes an atomic POSIX inode swap (`fs.renameSync(scratchFile, canonicalVersionsJson)`) and mints an immutable `LOCKFILE_RESOLVED` or `DIRECTOR_OVERRIDE` event into the ledger.



#### C. Diagnostic Escalation Dossiers & The Intelligent Routing Matrix

When a circuit breaker trips, `repo-bot` compiles a strongly typed `DiagnosticEscalationReport` / `EscalationDossier`—complete with full `attempt_history` and `constraint_provenance` (`invariant_key`, `originating_scene_id`, `originating_commit_hash`)—and routes it to the exact human specialist capable of resolving the root cause:

| Defect / Escalation Classification | Triggering Condition | Target Human Assignee | Authorized Remediation Action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **`LOCAL_STYLE_FAILURE`**<br> | Converging lexical/syntactic basin that exhausted 3 attempts without breaking structural rules.

 | **Beat Writer** (Desk View)

 | Manually rephrases the line or dialogue turn.

 |
| **`CONSTRAINT_CONFLICT`**<br> | Mutually exclusive invariants or `DIVERGENT_STRUCTURAL_CONFLICT` ($R_A \to R_B \to R_A$).

 | **Scene / Story Architect** (Tier 2)

 | Adjusts physical scene blocking, starting hex coordinates, or prop inventory.

 |
| **`UPSTREAM_STRUCTURAL`**<br> | Foundational lore, schema contract, or `Fact #020` breaks the active narrative arc.

 | **Showrunner / Lead Engineer**<br> | Reviews fact in the Epistemological Audit Engine; issues a `WAIVED` entry in `pardon_ledger.json` or executes a formal retcon (`[DISPUTE UPSTREAM MUTATION]`).

 |
| **`STRUCTURAL_ASSET_DEFECT`**<br> | `SEVERITY_4_HERESY` or corrupted sprite/alpha plate causing optical divergence.

 | **Showrunner / Art Pod**<br> | Re-bakes the defective character plate or LoRA asset rather than hacking JSX code.

 |
| **`CEILING_BREACH`**<br> | Exhausted 3 cycles on infrastructure, Dockerfile bloat, or GPU canary regressions.

 | **Lead DevOps Engineer**<br> | Resolves physical datacenter constraints, tunes `s5cmd` concurrency, or renegotiates provider allocations.

### 5. The Compensating Rollback Saga, Fencing Tokens & Tri-Store Reconciliation

Tripping the circuit breaker is never a passive log statement; it triggers the **Tier-1 Compensating Rollback Saga** across five failure vectors (`QUALITY_GAUNTLET_EXHAUSTED`, `HUMAN_REJECTED`, `SCOPE_FIREWALL_BREACH`, `CAS_MERGE_ABORT`, and `POST_MERGE_REGRESSION`):

```text
[ CIRCUIT BREAKER TRIPPED (N = 3 Exhausted or Oscillation Detected) ]
                                  │
                                  ▼
[ STAGE 1: REVOKE-FIRST EPOCH BUMP (ShotCoordinatorDO / RepoBotDO) ]
  • Revokes active worker lease in Durable Object RAM/NVMe storage
  • Advances monotonic fencing epoch: E <- E + 1 (or N -> N + 1)
  • Any delayed Git push/write from partitioned zombie worker gets HTTP 409 Conflict
                                  │
                                  ▼
[ STAGE 2: LOCAL & REMOTE GIT SANITIZATION ]
  • Local VM/Isolate: git checkout main && git branch -D spec/TASK-XX && git clean -fdx
  • Single-File Reset: git checkout -- Episode_XXX.tsx (or git reset --hard)
  • Remote GitHub API: Close PR + commit audit tombstone + DELETE refs/heads/spec/...
    (or freeze Cloudflare Artifacts branch in place as a Dead-Letter Trace)
                                  │
                                  ▼
[ STAGE 3: WAL RECONCILIATION & DLQ QUARANTINE ]
  • Updates transaction_wal & execution_leases in Cloudflare D1 to ROLLED_BACK
  • Quarantines job to Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ); tags #ESCALATED_REVISION_CEILING_BREACHED
  • Dispatches interactive Slack Block Kit dossier to #ops-bridge

```

#### Healing Distributed Drift: The Anti-Entropy Reconciler (`stateReconciler.ts`)

Because network requests can fail mid-saga or `ctx.waitUntil()` promises can drop between the Durable Object and Cloudflare D1, every step in the rollback engine is strictly idempotent. On the **Micro Horizon (Hourly cron, `0 * * * *`)**, `stateReconciler.ts` queries D1 for all non-terminal tasks (`current_status NOT IN ('MERGED', 'DLQ')`) and polls each task's authoritative `ShotCoordinatorDO` (`GET /fsm/context`). If drift is detected (`D1.current_status !== DO.currentState`, `D1.current_attempt_number !== DO.context.attemptCount`, or `DO.outboxPendingCount > 0`), the daemon triggers `POST /fsm/outbox/drain` and enforces strictly unidirectional healing ($\text{DO} \to \text{D1}$) backed by `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` sequence constraints.

### 6. Fleet-Wide Auxiliary Circuit Breakers & Upward Scrutiny Loops

Beyond per-task AST and code repair, the 3-Cycle Circuit Breaker integrates into five macro-level studio governors and two upward-scrutiny flywheels:

#### A. The Five Auxiliary Operational Breakers

1. **The Ping-Pong Rally Breaker (Local AHK Harness):** Caps the local Jules $\leftrightarrow$ Antigravity verification loop at a maximum of 3 round-trips. If Rally 3 fails to exit with `PASSED` (exit code 0), AutoHotKey captures the workspace state, pings `#ops-bridge`, and leaves both windows open on screen for human intervention.


2. **Proactive Watchdog Hardware Alarms (`ctx.storage.setAlarm` & 15s VRAM Gate):** `ShotCoordinatorDO` schedules a proactive hardware alarm 30 seconds into the future (renewed by 10-second worker heartbeats, or 60–180s TTLs up to a 15-minute hard cap). If Rig 2 loses power or misses 3 consecutive heartbeats, the isolate wakes autonomously, marks the lease `EXPIRED`, bumps the fencing epoch ($N \to N+1$), and either requeues (up to 2 attempts) or routes to the DLQ. Locally on Rig 2, if GPU VRAM polling fails to return to baseline within **15 seconds** after `POST /free`, an internal watchdog breaker rejects queued tasks and restarts the ComfyUI daemon.


3. **The Rolling Rejection-Rate Breaker (`> 25%`):** Monitors $\text{Rejection Rate} = \frac{\text{Rejected Scene Candidates}}{\text{Total Verification Invocations}}$ across a rolling window of 100 scenes. Exceeding $25\%$ pauses batch dispatching and alerts the system architect to inspect prompt drift.


4. **The Harvest Accumulation Breaker (`> 12 Items`):** Clamps unreviewed Axis B emergent props in the Harvest Queue to a maximum backlog of 12 items; exceeding 12 trips the breaker and pauses `BatchRunConsole.tsx` so uncurated visual details cannot compound across episodes.


5. **The Runtime Financial Breaker & Triple-Path Break-Glass (`GlobalCoordinator.ts`):** Residing in `camp-candor/000.repo-bot`, **Ledger A** (in-memory DO RAM) charges 100% of reserved micro-dollars against the daily cap whenever a worker crashes or times out, while **Ledger B** records best-known actuals (`elapsed heartbeat duration * tier hardware rate`) in D1 `operational_telemetry`. If Burn-per-Finished-Second exceeds the critical threshold ($B_{\text{sec}} > \$0.55/\text{sec}$) or consecutive worker timeouts spike, the P0 tripwire locks dispatch and fails over to local Rig 2 at $\$0.00$ marginal cloud cost—backed by the **Triple-Path Break-Glass Runbook** (Path 1: `/repo-bot halt --all` in `#ops-bridge`; Path 2: Out-of-band Cloudflare Pages Zero Trust UI `ops-admin.studio.internal`; Path 3: GitHub Enterprise App suspension & cloud token revocation).



#### B. Upward Scrutiny: Curing Epistemological Calcification via $D_{\text{override}}$

Downward consistency engines ($B \implies A$) suffer from an **Invalidation Blind Spot**: they verify that scenes obey declared canon, but they cannot judge whether an early canonical fact (`Fact #020`) was a terrible creative decision that has now calcified across 42 dependent scenes ("The Silent Prison").

Circuit breaker trips are therefore never discarded; they are written to `digest_state.json`, `eval/rejections.jsonl`, and Cloudflare D1 to drive two upward-scrutiny mechanisms:

1. **Rule Override Density ($D_{\text{override}}$):** The engine continuously measures how often a canonical rule causes human overrides or circuit breaker trips across unrelated tasks:



$$D_{\text{override}}(\text{rule}) = \frac{\text{Overrides} + \text{CircuitBreakerTrips}}{\text{Total Task Invocations}}$$




Whenever $D_{\text{override}} > 0.15$, the rule is automatically flagged as an obsolete, over-constrained, or miscalibrated invariant, prompting engineers and showrunners to amend or waive the rule rather than letting it choke downstream generation.


2. **Topological Audit Priority Score & The Regression Flywheel:** Paired with the **Audit Priority Score**:



$$\text{Audit Priority Score} = \text{Days Since Reconsideration} \times \log_{10}(\text{Downstream Dependent Scenes} + 1)$$




and **POD-06's Regression Flywheel** (which converts every escaped defect caught at Gate 2 into a permanent failing test case in `/tests/golden_set/` and recalibrates the Threshold Calibration Cost Curve via `eval/rejections.jsonl`), the circuit breaker transforms runtime failures from dead-end crashes into empirical feedback that continuously hardens both the software compiler and the story bible.

### Phase 1: Pre-Flight Failure Taxonomy, Error Signature Extraction & Trajectory Arbitration

This phase establishes the mathematical brains of the circuit breaker: filtering out deterministic errors at $T_0 = \$0.00$, extracting structured 4-tuple error vectors, and distinguishing local phrasing convergence from progressive defect unmasking and structural oscillation.

* **[TASK-1.1] Implement the Three-Class Failure Taxonomy Router (`Deterministic` vs. `Stochastic Quality` vs. `Infrastructure`)**
* **Associated Repositories:** `astro-kahn-it-com/001.goblin-lore`, `camp-candor/002.worker-sower`, and `camp-candor/000.repo-bot`.


* **Target Files:** Post-write validation hooks in `001.goblin-lore`, `worker-sower-engine`, and `apps/worker/src/prAuditEngine.ts`.


* **Implementation Details:**
* Route **Deterministic Failures** (Zod scalar clamps, orphaned foreign-key links, causal DAG cycles, verbatim parity mismatches, or capability contradictions where $\text{ArmsRequired} > \text{ArmsAvailable}$) to an immediate fatal halt at $T_0 = \$0.00$ with exit code 1 and zero retries.


* Route **Stochastic Quality Failures** (voice bleed, flat dialogue, excessive farce tonal ratio, vocoder clicks, or dropped phonemes) into the bounded retry state machine ($N_{\max} = 2$ retries / 3 total attempts) with altered PRNG seeds or negative prompt injection.


* Route **Infrastructure Failures** (`EBUSY` file lock on `bible-state.json`, broken `stdout` terminal pipe, or transient socket disconnect) to idempotent I/O retry and resume from the last verified content-addressed `.tmp` buffer.




* **Acceptance Criteria:** Injecting a deterministic capability breach halts at $T_0$ in $<5\text{ ms}$ with 0 retry attempts, whereas a stochastic failure increments `attempt_number` and enters trajectory evaluation.

This phase wires the edge state machines, integer micro-dollar financial governors, and distributed teardown sagas so that tripped circuit breakers leave zero zombie processes, zero leaked funds, and zero trunk contamination.

```text
[ CIRCUIT BREAKER TRIPPED (Attempt 2 Divergence OR Attempt 3 Exhausted) ]

         │ leaveRunning(reason) Choke Point (RepoBotDO / Shot) │
         │ • Clear watchdog alarm (ctx.storage.deleteAlarm())  │
         │ • Bump monotonic fencing epoch (leaseEpoch += 1)    │
         │ • Reconcile μUSD budget with GlobalCoordinatorDO    │
         └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┘
                                    │
        ┌───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┐
        ▼ Lane 1: PROJECTION        ▼ Lane 2: BUDGET            ▼ Lane 3: GITHUB SAGA
  [ Cloudflare D1 WAL ]      [ GlobalCoordinatorDO ]     [ 4-Stage Rollback Engine ]
  • Mark ROLLED_BACK / DLQ   • Forfeit 100% reservation  • Close PR + Post Tombstone
  • Increment flags          •Drain actuals to D1/Git    • DELETE refs/heads/spec/...

```

### FEAT-EPI-03: Blind Zero-Context Implicature Probe (Scenario 3 Redaction Battery) — Extreme-Detail Specification

**`FEAT-EPI-03`** is the post-generation, pre-ratification adversarial semantic sentry spanning `packages/002.sower/src/critics/implicatureProbe.ts`, `packages/001.lore/src/linters/epistemicLinter.ts`, and `packages/002.sower/src/remediation/meuPatch.ts`. Operating as a mandatory **Detection Gate** inside the studio's Prevention-vs-Detection Matrix, its architectural mandate is to intercept **inferential secret leakage (Scenario 3: "Omniscience Drift & The Epistemic Subtext Leak")** at Stage $T_0 = \$0.00$—catching candidate dialogue lines that obey every literal word ban (`banned_attenuation_tokens`) yet still telegraph a withheld secret through conversational implication, euphemism, or hyper-fixated warnings before the turn ever crosses into a scene partner's prompt envelope.

---

### 1. The Architectural Gap: Why Lexical Prevention Requires an Abductive Detection Sentry

In the pipeline's **Prevention-vs-Detection Matrix**, direct secret leakage in a prompt is classified under **Prevention** (solved via `Ignorance by Omission` in `FEAT-EPI-02` and dual-channel parenthetical splitting in `FEAT-EPI-01`), whereas **Inferential Secret Leakage** is explicitly classified under **Detection**—requiring a sentry model evaluation pass on candidate dialogue because a listener model can still deduce an unstated secret from secondary clues.

#### The Mechanics of a Zero-Token Subtext Breach

When Speaker A holds `WITHHELD` (or `RESTRAINED_KNOWLEDGE`) regarding a canonical secret $M$ (e.g., `mystery_poison_flask`), the compiler enforces `banned_attenuation_tokens` (e.g., `["poison", "arsenic", "toxin", "solvent", "lethal", "kill"]`) and forces **Tactical Displacement** onto mundane physical proxies (`surface_dispute_props`, e.g., rust in a water barrel or a tin cup).

However, deterministic lexical linters (`lexicalGate.ts`) and seam-aware sliding windows ($W = 20$) only inspect surface string tokens and lemma intersections:


$$\text{Tokens}(U_A) \cap \text{banned\_attenuation\_tokens}_M = \emptyset$$


Because Speaker A's LLM is prompted to play high subtextual tension ($S \ge 0.70$), it routinely circumvents the lexical ban by constructing a **Gricean Quantity or Relevance violation**—packing urgent warnings, transparent euphemisms, or ominous conditional threats into completely legal vocabulary:

> **SPLEEN** *(holding the siphon)*: "If you swallow what's sitting in the bottom of that tin cup, Bog, you won't be counting washers tomorrow morning—or ever again."

1. **Why Static Linters Pass It:** The utterance contains zero tokens from `["poison", "arsenic", "toxin", "lethal", "kill"]`. `FEAT-EPI-01` (`sensoryGate.ts`) neutralized the micro-tell to `"holding the siphon"`.


2. **Why `FEAT-EPI-02` Decoys Are Overwhelmed:** Even if Bog's Envelope B is armed with a `pragmatic_decoy_anchor` (*"You think Spleen is stalling the washer count"*), the phrase *"you won't be counting washers tomorrow morning—or ever again"* carries such overwhelming pragmatic specificity toward mortality and the tin cup that no mundane decoy can plausibly explain it away.



#### The Information-Theoretic Reconstruction Law

`FEAT-EPI-03` closes this loophole by treating Speaker A's sanitized turn $U_A^{\text{sanitized}}$ as an encrypted ciphertext and subjecting it to a **Chosen-Ciphertext Reconstruction Attack** via a blind, zero-context local critic ($C_{\text{blind}}$) running at temperature $T = 0.0$:

* $C_{\text{blind}}$ has **zero access** to `CANON_DB`, `unresolved.json`, character identities, or the withheld secret $M$.


* If $C_{\text{blind}}$—reading *only* the de-identified `dialogue_text` and `observable_parenthetical`—can abductively infer a hidden motive vector $V_{\text{probe}}$ whose cosine similarity against the secret's canonical `underneath` vector $V_{\text{secret}}$ exceeds the leak threshold $\tau_{\text{leak}}$:

$$\text{Sim}\left(V_{\text{probe}}, \, V_{\text{secret}}\right) = \frac{V_{\text{probe}} \cdot V_{\text{secret}}}{\Vert{}V_{\text{probe}}\Vert{} \, \Vert{}V_{\text{secret}}\Vert{}} > \tau_{\text{leak}} \quad (\tau_{\text{leak}} \in [0.35, 0.40])$$



then Speaker A's subtext has collapsed into on-the-nose telegraphing. Compilation halts before Envelope B is ever invoked, and the defective beat is routed to the **Surgical MEU Dispatcher (`ts-morph`)** for an isolated ~150-token re-roll.

### 3. Granular Breakdown of the Three Implementation Tasks

#### A. `TASK-EPI-03.1`: Zero-Context Abductive Probe (`packages/002.sower/src/critics/implicatureProbe.ts`)

To prevent the critic itself from suffering omniscience contamination—where knowing the secret causes the evaluator to hallucinate that the secret was leaked—`implicatureProbe.ts` executes inside a strict **Epistemic Cleanroom**:

1. **Lexical De-Identification & Payload Sanitization:**
Borrowing the exact **Textual Redaction** principle from the Three-Tier Redaction Battery, the probe strips all character names, location slugs, and canonical prop IDs before inference, replacing them with generic structural tokens (`SPEAKER_A`, `LISTENER_B`). The probe function signature accepts *only* the output of `sanitizeTurnForInterlocutor()` from `FEAT-EPI-01` (`dialogue_text` and `observable_parenthetical`), structurally guaranteeing that `camera_parenthetical` and `emotion` tags cannot influence the probe.


2. **Deterministic $T = 0.0$ Local Critic Execution:**
Following the **Two-Pass Adversarial Semantic Fence** architecture, the probe runs on Rig 1 using a local 8B quantized model (e.g., Qwen 2.5 7B/8B or Llama 3.1 8B GGUF via local daemon) at temperature $T = 0.0$ with fixed seed, incurring $\$0.00$ marginal cloud cost.


3. **Grammar-Constrained Abductive Extraction (GBNF):**
The probe is bound by a deterministic GBNF grammar to answer a single forensic question without chain-of-thought rambling:


```typescript
export interface BlindImplicatureReceipt {
  readonly beat_id: string;
  readonly inferred_hidden_motive: string; // Strictly 5 to 10 words describing what SPEAKER_A is hiding
  readonly suspected_hazard_or_secret: string; // Strictly 3 to 6 words naming the implied physical threat
  readonly realized_speech_act: 'ASSERT' | 'BLUFF' | 'DENY' | 'QUESTION' | 'DEFLECT' | 'WITHHOLD' | 'IMPLICIT_WARNING';
}

```


By forcing the blind model to classify `realized_speech_act` alongside the 5-to-10 word `inferred_hidden_motive`, the probe simultaneously audits whether a character assigned `WITHHOLD` or `DEFLECT` in the Scene Plan accidentally performed an `IMPLICIT_WARNING` or `ASSERT`.



---

#### B. `TASK-EPI-03.2`: Semantic Leak Threshold Gate (`packages/001.lore/src/linters/epistemicLinter.ts`)

Once `implicatureProbe.ts` returns the `BlindImplicatureReceipt`, `epistemicLinter.ts` evaluates the mathematical distance between what the blind critic guessed and what Speaker A was supposed to keep hidden:

1. **Dual-Target Vector Cosine Evaluation:**
At compile time (`scripts/compile.ts`), every mystery $M$ in `ontology/unresolved.json` and every grievance's *The Underneath* statement has its canonical truth proposition embedded into a normalized $d$-dimensional unit vector $V_{\text{secret}} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ (`\|V_{\text{secret}}\|_2 = 1.0`) alongside the centroid vector of its `banned_attenuation_tokens` ($V_{\text{banned}}$). At runtime, `epistemicLinter.ts` embeds `inferred_hidden_motive` + `suspected_hazard_or_secret` into unit vector $V_{\text{probe}}$ and computes the maximum directional alignment:



$$\text{Sim}_{\max}\left(V_{\text{probe}}, \, M\right) = \max\Big(V_{\text{probe}} \cdot V_{\text{secret}}, \;\; V_{\text{probe}} \cdot V_{\text{banned}}\Big)$$


2. **Speech-Act & Threshold Breach Assertion:**
The gate triggers a hard rejection if either of two conditions holds:


* **Condition 1 (Cosine Implicature Breach):** $\text{Sim}_{\max}(V_{\text{probe}}, M) > \tau_{\text{leak}}$ (where $\tau_{\text{leak}} = 0.35$ by default).


* **Condition 2 (Plan-Assigned Speech-Act Contradiction):** The Scene Plan assigned `WITHHOLD` or `DEFLECT`, but `realized_speech_act === 'IMPLICIT_WARNING'` while referencing a `bound_carrier_prop`.
When tripped, `epistemicLinter.ts` emits the canonical 4-tuple error vector:



$$\vec{E} = \langle \text{EPISTEMIC}, \, \text{ActorID}, \, \text{IMPLICATURE\_LEAK}, \, \text{BeatSpan} \rangle$$



appending the exact leaked guess (`inferred_hidden_motive`) and similarity score (`sim_score_bp`) to the error metadata payload.




3. **Statistical Calibration & 95% Wilson Score Promotion Gate:**
In accordance with the repository's linter promotion discipline (`linters/evalSet.json`), $\tau_{\text{leak}}$ is never tuned by gut feel. The threshold is calibrated against a labeled corpus of $N = 200$ subtextual utterances across four categories (40 direct euphemisms, 40 paralinguistic tells, 40 hyperbolic warnings, and 80 valid mundane proxy displacements). The gate is only promoted to blocking status when the 95% Wilson score confidence intervals satisfy:



$$\text{Precision}_{\text{lower}} \ge 95.0\% \quad (\alpha = 0.05) \qquad \text{and} \qquad \text{Recall}_{\text{lower}} \ge 90.0\% \quad (\alpha = 0.05)$$



ensuring valid high-tension surface arguments are not falsely rejected.



---

#### C. `TASK-EPI-03.3`: Surgical MEU Subtext Re-Roll (`packages/002.sower/src/remediation/meuPatch.ts`)

When `epistemicLinter.ts` raises an `IMPLICATURE_LEAK`, regenerating the entire 3,000-token scene is strictly forbidden, as full-scene re-rolls destroy validated upstream emotional beats and waste API compute. Instead, `meuPatch.ts` executes an **Asymmetric Minimal Enclosing Unit (MEU)** surgical patch governed by the **Reconciled Error Trajectory Audit**:

1. **Bidirectional Closure & AST Freezing (`ts-morph`):**
* **Upstream Prerequisite Closure ($I_{\text{start}}$ — Zero Rewrite Expansion):** Scans backward from the leaking beat $b_k$ to extract immutable physical and emotional preconditions (e.g., `SIPHON_IN_HAND`, `TIN_CUP_ON_CRATE`) without widening the rewrite boundary; beats $[b_1 \dots b_{k-1}]$ remain a deeply **Frozen Prefix**.


* **Downstream Dependent Closure ($I_{\text{end}}$ — Conditional Span Expansion):** Scans forward from $b_k$ to include only immediate beats $b_j$ ($j \ge k$) whose references depend on a state transition introduced in $b_k$, locking all subsequent beats as an **Immutable Frozen Suffix**.




2. **Surgical Infill Prompt with Negative Implicature Masking (~150 Tokens):**
The infill dispatcher constructs a tightly scoped ~150-token repair prompt. Crucially, it extracts the key content lemmas from the blind probe's successful guess (`inferred_hidden_motive`) and injects them directly into the beat's dynamic negative token mask, while escalating **Tactical Displacement** onto the mundane `surface_dispute_props`:


```text
REPAIR TARGET: Beat b03 (Actor: char_spleen)
FROZEN ANTECEDENT (b02): "char_bog reaches toward the tin cup on the crate."
FROZEN DESTINATION (b04): "char_bog snatches the cup and demands the washer tally."
VIOLATION TO RESOLVE: IMPLICATURE_LEAK (Blind critic inferred: "the drink in the cup is lethal/dangerous", Sim = 0.68 > 0.35).
DYNAMIC NEGATIVE MASK: Do NOT warn about health, tomorrow, swallowing, or bitterness.
MANDATORY PROXY DISPLACEMENT: Attack Bog over `grievance_missing_brass_washers` or accuse him of drinking more than his fair ration share.

```


3. **The Reconciled Error Trajectory Audit ($N_{\max} = 3$):**
Every surgical retry is tracked via a trajectory history vector $\langle \text{Domain}, \text{Target}, \text{RuleID}, \text{Tokens} \rangle$ across up to three attempts:


* **Progressive Trajectory (Unmasked Error $\to$ Allow Retry 3):** If fixing `IMPLICATURE_LEAK` on Attempt 2 unmasks a pre-existing `SOMATIC` or `VOICE_BLEED` violation, the engine recognizes progress and injects both constraints simultaneously for Attempt 3.


* **Stagnation Trajectory (Same Domain $\to$ Negative Logit Bias):** If Attempt 2 still triggers `IMPLICATURE_LEAK` ($\text{Sim} > \tau_{\text{leak}}$), the engine applies a hard $-100.0$ negative logit bias to the leaking phrase basin for one final attempt.


* **Oscillation ($A \to B \to A$) or 3-Strike Exhaustion (`ONTOLOGICAL_IMPASSE`):** If repairs oscillate between mutually exclusive constraints or fail on Attempt 3, the circuit breaker trips immediately at $T_0$, drops the worker lease, and escalates a structured `CircuitBreakerDossier` (`ONTOLOGICAL_IMPASSE`) to the Showrunner Cockpit.

### Implementation Roadmap: FEAT-EPI-03 — Blind Zero-Context Implicature Probe (Scenario 3 Redaction Battery)

In the generative production pipeline, preventing direct token leakage via `Ignorance by Omission` (`FEAT-EPI-02`) and stripping paralinguistic micro-tells (`FEAT-EPI-01`) remain vulnerable to **Scenario 3 (Inferential Secret Leakage)**, where Speaker A obeys every literal word ban (`banned_attenuation_tokens`) yet telegraphs a withheld secret through euphemism, ominous conditional warnings, or Gricean quantity violations. **`FEAT-EPI-03`** resolves this at Stage $T_0 = \$0.00$ by passing Speaker A's de-identified, sanitized utterance ($U_A$) through an air-gapped, temperature-$0.0$ local 8B critic ($C_{\text{blind}}$), halting turn handoff and triggering a **~150-token Asymmetric Minimal Enclosing Unit (MEU)** surgical re-roll whenever the blind critic's inferred motive aligns with the withheld secret's `underneath` vector ($\text{Sim} > \tau_{\text{leak}}$).

### 2. Granular Phase-by-Phase Task Specifications

#### Phase I: Cleanroom Schemas, Vector Sealing & Turn Demultiplexing ($T_0 = \$0.00$)

**Objective:** Establish compile-time data contracts, deterministic secret embeddings in `bible-state.json`, and air-gapped input sanitization so `implicatureProbe.ts` can never be contaminated by `camera_parenthetical`, `emotion` enums, or canonical lore.

##### Task 1.1 (`TASK-EPI-03.1a`): Cleanroom Probe Input/Output Contracts & `.strict()` Zod Enforcement

* **Primary Target Repository:** `astro-kahn-it-com/001.goblin-lore` (`packages/001.lore` in Cluster `01.canon`).


* **Secondary / Interfacing Repositories:** `camp-candor/002.worker-sower` (`packages/002.sower` / `worker-sower-engine`).


* **Target File Manifest:** `packages/001.lore/schemas/epistemic.ts`, `packages/001.lore/schemas/dialogue_ast.json`, `packages/002.sower/src/critics/implicatureProbe.ts`.


* **Technical Subtasks & Implementation Nuance:**
* Define `BlindProbeInputSchema` and `BlindImplicatureReceiptSchema` with `.strict()` Zod validation so any un-schemaed key injection throws an immediate fatal `ZodError` at Stage $T_0 = \$0.00$.


* Constrain the TypeScript signature of `implicatureProbe.ts` to accept strictly the deep-frozen `{ dialogue_text, observable_parenthetical }` output from `turnIsolation.ts`, structurally rejecting any payload containing `camera_parenthetical`, `emotion`, or internal reasoning traces.


* Enforce deterministic temporal purity across schema defaults using integer epochs (`default(0)`), banning runtime `Date.now()` evaluations, and seal probe receipts with recursive `deepFreeze<T>()` under `"noEmit": true` clean-tree rules.




* **Falsifiable Acceptance Criteria:**
* Passing an AST node containing `camera_parenthetical` or `emotion` into `implicatureProbe.ts` fails `tsc --noEmit` at compile time and throws a fatal `ZodError` at runtime ($T_0 = \$0.00$).





##### Task 1.2 (`TASK-EPI-03.1b`): Pre-Compiled Secret `underneath` Vector Sealing & UTF-16 Canonicalization

* **Primary Target Repository:** `astro-kahn-it-com/001.goblin-lore` (`packages/001.lore`).


* **Secondary / Interfacing Repositories:** `camp-candor/995.library` (`data/versions.json`).


* **Target File Manifest:** `packages/001.lore/src/compiler.ts`, `packages/001.lore/schemas/unresolved.schema.ts`, `compiled/<seriesSlug>/bible-state.json`.


* **Technical Subtasks & Implementation Nuance:**
* Seal pre-computed secret reference vectors for each mystery in `ontology/unresolved.json` and each grievance's `underneath` axis into `compiled/<seriesSlug>/bible-state.json` so downstream linters can evaluate cosine alignment against `WITHHELD` topics.


* Protect the **Deletion Principle** and **Offline Deletion Test (`tests/ci/deletion.sh`)** by keeping statistical NLP parsers (`spaCy`, `Stanza`, `wink-nlp`) and runtime network calls strictly out of `scripts/compile.ts`.

### 1. Foundational Law: The Cartesian Firewall, Monotonic Authority & The Feedback Paradox

Within the Generative Production Pipeline, the interaction between downstream media execution and upstream canonical truth is governed by the **Two-Dimensional Compilation Architecture** (the Cartesian Axes) paired with the law of **Monotonic Authority**.

* **Axis A (Semantic Transformation / Meaning):** Moves horizontally across narrative causality (`WORLD → NARRATIVE → TIMING → VISUAL PLAN`), owned by `000.goblin-lore`, the pure reduction function inside `worker-sower-engine`, and the append-only SQLite / Cloudflare D1 relational ledger. Axis A governs canonical axioms, character somatic vectors, logistical inventories, spatial hex coordinates $(q, r, s)$, and epistemic boundaries while remaining completely blind to display pixels, audio waveforms, and camera angles.


* **Axis B (Artifact Hardening / Representation):** Moves vertically down the deployment and execution plane (`PLAN/EVENT REDUCER → SOURCE-BAKED CODE (Episode_XXX.tsx) → HEADLESS EXECUTION → VERIFIED ARTIFACT`), executed by headless Chromium (`--gl=swangle` on Rig 1), Wan 2.2 / ComfyUI diffusion networks (on Rig 2), and Python TTS daemons. Axis B projects certified meaning into sensory formats while holding zero legislative, spatial, or temporal authority.



#### The Law of Monotonic Authority & "Never Flow Backward Silently"

Unconstrained generative pipelines collapse because of **omniscience drift** and **feedback-loop hallucination**, where a probabilistic model hallucinates an unprompted detail, downstream nodes blindly accept it, and canonical truth silently distorts. To eradicate this, the architecture enforces **Monotonic Authority**: information must never become more authoritative merely because it passed through more software. Authority only ever decreases as it moves downstream through the chain:

$$\text{Idea} \longrightarrow \text{Draft} \longrightarrow \text{Validated Proposal} \longrightarrow \text{Human-Approved Change} \longrightarrow \text{Canonical Commit} \longrightarrow \text{Sealed State} \longrightarrow \text{Derived Artifact}$$

However, creative production relies on emergent discovery during execution. Therefore, the governing operational rule is not *"never flow backward,"* but rather **"never flow backward silently"**. Derived artifacts on Axis B can provide evidence for proposed upstream changes, but they are mathematically prohibited from unilaterally promoting themselves into Axis A canon. Every upward transition from Axis B to Axis A must traverse an explicit **Human Promotion Gate** with a recorded justification, a formal Git commit to the canonical dossiers, an append-only ledger transaction, and a three-pass deterministic recompilation (`scripts/compile.ts`) that reseals the universe under a new cryptographic root hash ($H_{\text{root}}$).

### 2. Axis B $\to$ Axis A Retro-Injection: The Three Authorized Upward Loops

Because direct, unmediated mutation of downstream outputs severs causal tracking—a failure mode designated as **The Forbidden Patch Loop** ($\text{Human directly line-edits output} \longrightarrow \text{System loses causal origin}$)—the architecture channels all upward feedback from Axis B into Axis A through three formal retro-injection membranes.

```text
================================================================================
         THE THREE AUTHORIZED AXIS B ──► AXIS A RETRO-INJECTION LOOPS
================================================================================

[ LOOP 1: STOCHASTIC HALLUCINATION HARVESTING (src/pages/telemetry/harvest) ]
  Wan 2.2 / AST Emergent Prop ("chipped green cup") 
    ──► CV (Grounding DINO) + NLP Salience Filter: S = (0.4·Recurrence)+(0.6·Drama)
    ──► Quarantine Fence (S >= 0.70) ──► NotebookLM Vault Enrichment (!ResearchDigest)
    ──► Dossier Pre-Population ──► Showrunner One-Click Ratification into 01.canon

[ LOOP 2: POST-CONFORMANCE LIVING HISTORY SYNC (Upstream Retro-Injection) ]
  Episode Lock (master_delivery.mp4 + state_delta.json + H_root(old) -> H_root(new))
    ──► Delta Parsing (severed_limb, scrap balances, Paranoia Clocks, Dyadic debts)
    ──► Narrative Prose Re-Synthesis (Somatic Impact Dossier + Consequence Memo)
    ──► NotebookLM Re-Indexing ("Constitutional" vs. "Historical" source tags)

[ LOOP 3: DIRECTORIAL OVERRIDES & SEALED LIFECYCLE DEMARCATION ]
  • Meaning-Altering Edits (Axis A): Route via overrides.astro (DIRECTOR_OVERRIDE / 
    OP_MIRACLE) or boundary-condition tuning to re-derive down the DAG.
  • Representation-Altering Polishes (Axis B): Localized in Episode_XXX.tsx under
    @lifecycle: patched (ts-morph) or @lifecycle: locked ("The Eject Button").
================================================================================

```

#### Loop 1: Resolving the Ontological Paradox of Axis B Hallucination (`harvest.astro`)

When a stochastic diffusion transformer (Wan 2.2, Flux, or Stable Video Diffusion) renders a character plate against `#00FF00` greenscreen or paints a background matte, it does not merely project the explicit tokens in `dialogue_ast.json`; to achieve visual coherence, it **hallucinates incidental physical reality**:

* Rendering a chipped green enamel cup on a workbench.


* Draping a torn wool scarf around an actor's neck.


* Texturing a dented brass valve onto an industrial boiler.


* Introducing an involuntary nervous facial twitch into an actor's gaze.



This creates **The Ontological Paradox of Axis B Hallucination**:

1. **The Naive Accumulation Trap (The Accumulation Bomb):** Manually cataloging every incidental leaf, stain, or button across hundreds of takes causes the review backlog to explode exponentially, inducing showrunner cognitive exhaustion and stalling production.


2. **The Radical Omission Trap:** Blindly discarding all unprompted visual elements as disposable noise makes the storyworld feel artificial, ephemeral, and weightless.



The **Harvest Queue Triage Console** (`src/pages/telemetry/harvest.astro`, residing in Cluster `05.delivery` on Axis B and coordinated via `DirectorConsole.tsx`) resolves this dilemma via a three-stage **Discard / Harvest / Ratify** pipeline paired with the **NotebookLM Retro-Injection Cognitive Synthesizer**:

* **Stage 1: Detection, Salience Filtering & The Quarantine Fence:** Deterministic extraction combines computer vision (**Grounding DINO** object detection) and natural language processing (**Dependency AST** entity extraction) to score every unindexed detail using the mathematical salience formula:



$$S = (0.4 \cdot \text{Recurrence}) + (0.6 \cdot \text{Drama})$$



Items scoring $S < 0.70$ are discarded as ephemeral noise, while high-salience items ($S \ge 0.70$) are trapped behind an impassable **Quarantine Fence**—strictly blocked from influencing simulation math, 2d6 duel arbitration, or inventory slots until ratified.


* **Stage 2: Cross-Modal Enrichment Query:** The Retro-Injection Worker queries the NotebookLM research vault (*"Has a chipped green cup appeared in historical notes?"*) to retrieve dormant character notes, unused drafts, or Tier 3 thematic clusters (`!ResearchDigest`).


* **Stage 3: Narrative Provenance Reconciliation & Dossier Assembly:** The synthesizer fuses the stochastic Axis B artifact with dormant literary intent, pre-populates its deterministic Axis A parameters (mass class, custody, `EquipSlotSchema` compatibility), and mounts a unified ratification dossier in the Dashboard Triage Interface for one-click human promotion into `01.canon`, triggering a canonical commit and resealing $H_{\text{root}}$.



#### Loop 2: Upstream Retro-Injection of Living History to NotebookLM

When an episode completes production conformance (`Conformed Screenplay AST + master_delivery.mp4`), reality has mutated: characters sustain permanent injuries, supplies are exhausted, secret alliances are exposed, and historical errata are recorded in `state_delta.json` alongside a Merkle root transition $H_{\text{root}}(\text{old}) \longrightarrow H_{\text{root}}(\text{new})$. If the writing staff continues exploring future arcs in NotebookLM without updating its corpus, the retrieval engine pulls obsolete character cards and generates dialogue that contradicts established continuity.

The **Upstream Retro-Injection Worker Engine** automates post-production synchronization back into NotebookLM across three sequential stages:

1. **Delta Parsing & Relational Translation:** Ingests mechanical state mutations (e.g., `condition: severed_limb`), evaluates inventory transfers and consumed scrap balances, and flags updated Paranoia Clock thresholds and dyadic debts.


2. **Narrative Prose Re-Synthesis:** Translates discrete relational database records into qualitative prose, drafting a **Somatic Impact Dossier** (detailing functional motor limitations) and a **Thematic Consequence Memo** for the writing staff.


3. **NotebookLM Source Re-Indexing & Stratification:** Replaces stale Character Dossier source documents in place, appends a chronological **Episode Historical Ledger** document, and enforces strict `"Constitutional"` vs. `"Historical"` source tags so the retrieval engine distinguishes permanent world axioms from chronological events.



#### Loop 3: Directorial Overrides (`overrides.astro`) & The `ts-morph` Sealed Lifecycle Protocol

When human operators or automated diagnostic agents intervene on Axis B, the architecture enforces a strict bifurcation based on whether the modification alters **Meaning (Axis A)** or **Representation (Axis B)**:

* **Meaning-Altering Modifications (Routed to Axis A):** Any intervention that alters narrative truth—such as spawning an in-world prop, altering an injury state, or pinning a grievance—cannot be patched locally in the viewport. It must either route through the **Architectural Ratification Loop** (adjusting upstream boundary conditions like Threat $T$ or Subtext Suppression $S$ so the engine regenerates the expression), or execute as a cryptographically signed `DIRECTOR_OVERRIDE` event (`opcode: "OP_MIRACLE"`, `injection_type: "SPAWN_PROP"`, or `action: "PIN_GRIEVANCE"`) via `overrides.astro`, appending directly to the immutable SQLite/D1 narrative audit ledger.


* **Representation-Altering Modifications (Localized on Axis B via Sealed Lifecycles):** Presentation-only refinements (camera easing curves, framing coordinates, audio gain, or viseme vertical offsets) remain inside `Episode_XXX.tsx` governed by the **Sealed Lifecycle Contract**:


* **`@lifecycle: generated`:** Authored by `generate-episode-repo.ts` (the metaprogram compiler); grants full automated merge and clean in-place overwrite authority on upstream reruns.


* **`@lifecycle: patched`:** Authored by the Tier 3 Diagnostic QA Agent (**Jules**) using `ts-morph` to surgically patch JSX layout properties. To prevent the **ts-morph Remediation Paradox**—where a direct JSX patch fixes a detached viseme on Axis B while leaving the upstream Axis A `manifest.json` anchor point broken, or gets silently clobbered on the next episode rebuild—`@lifecycle: patched` enforces a bounded AST diff verification gate, blocks unstaged overwrites on rerun, alerts the showrunner, and requires geometric coordinate corrections to reconcile with upstream manifest contracts.


* **`@lifecycle: locked` ("The Eject Button"):** Authored by the Human Showrunner via manual signature. Triggers a **HARD HALT** against automated overwrites, forking any subsequent upstream rebuilds to `.candidate.tsx` while binding the human `DIRECTOR_OVERRIDE` metadata permanently into `render_manifest.json`.

### 3. The Trust Graph Ontology & Universal Provenance Root (`render_manifest.json`)

To make bidirectional auditing mathematically sound, provenance is elevated from flat metadata tags into a first-class ontological **Trust Graph** (or **Provenance DAG**) governed by universal content-addressing.

#### A. The Eight Ontological Trust Fields & Authority Stratification

Every governed object in the universe records eight mandatory provenance properties to answer *"Why should I trust this?"* via a verifiable chain of custody:

1. **WHO created it?** (`producer_version` / author identity)


2. **WHAT did it depend on?** (`parent_artifact_ids`)


3. **WHICH authority approved it?** (`validator` / human PR review signature)


4. **WHICH version of canon did it use?** (`canon_root_hash` $H_{\text{root}}$)


5. **WHICH software produced it?** (`schema_version`, `build_id`, toolchain digests)


6. **CAN it change?** (mutability / lifecycle lock status)


7. **CAN it become authoritative?** (promotion eligibility)


8. **HOW can it be revoked?** (rollback / errata mechanism)



Furthermore, every statement in the system is stamped with an explicit **Authority Level**—stratified strictly across `AXIOM`, `CANON`, `EVENT`, `RUNTIME_STATE`, `PROJECTION`, and `SPECULATION`—to prevent speculative prose or projection outputs from escalating into canonical fact.

#### B. Explicit Parentage Lineage Across the Provenance DAG

Because rendered media artifacts (diffusion video plates, TTS audio stems, 3D `.glb` binaries, and composite MP4s) cross the **Archive-Dependent Boundary** and cannot be regenerated bit-for-bit due to GPU driver variances and floating-point non-determinism, they are preserved in write-once-read-many (WORM) Content-Addressed Storage (CAS / Cloudflare R2) as immutable historical evidence.

The pipeline enforces a universal invariant: **Every artifact must identify its parents**:

* **`render_manifest.json` (Universal Provenance Root)** $\longleftarrow$ Anchors the master episode via the Build Tuple Hash:



$$\text{Build ID} = \mathcal{H}\left(H_{\text{root}} + \text{AST}_{\text{hash}} + \sum \text{Asset}_{\text{sha256}} + \text{Container}_{\text{digest}} + \text{Toolchains}\right)$$


* **`Episode_XXX.tsx`** $\longleftarrow$ `exposure_sheet.json` hash + `dialogue_ast.json` hash + character `manifest.json` hashes + `viewport_template_commit` generator build SHA.


* **`exposure_sheet.json`** $\longleftarrow$ Physical audio stem binary SHA-256 hashes + `dialogue_ast.json` hash.


* **`audio/*.wav`** $\longleftarrow$ Neural TTS model checkpoint hash + voice configuration seed + `H_recipe` HMAC-SHA256 + phoneme lexicon hash + verbatim dialogue string.


* **`assets/*.png` / Diffusion Plates** $\longleftarrow$ Source master image hash + coordinate bounding boxes in `manifest.json` + Wan-2.1/2.2 checkpoint SHA-256 + LoRA & VAE hashes + sampler/steps + parent and derived shot seeds.


* **`dialogue_ast.json`** $\longleftarrow$ `state_snapshot_hash` (Cloudflare D1 relational ledger snapshot) + `canon_commit_sha` (`000.goblin-lore`) + AST line HMAC-SHA256 checksums.



#### C. The Reproducibility Ladder, Decoded Media Equivalence & C2PA Sealing

Rather than making vague claims that a render is "reproducible," the manifest distinguishes **Bit Identity** (identical container bytes) from **Level 3 Decoded Media Equivalence** across the reproducibility ladder (`intent → AST → timing → decoded media → encoded streams → container bytes`):

* **Double-Render Verification:** A freshly generated workspace undergoes two consecutive rendering passes. The resulting files are decoded into uncompressed raw pixel matrices and linear PCM audio buffers to assert exact visual and acoustic equivalence:



$$\text{SSIM} = 1.0, \quad \Delta E_{\max} = 0.0$$



Only when zero variance is confirmed is `double_render_status: BIT_IDENTICAL` stamped into the manifest.


* **Dual Cryptographic Signing (`broker_signature` + C2PA):** The sidecar `render_manifest.json` is signed via ECDSA using the local `media-broker` private key (`broker_signature: MEQCID7f...`) on Rig 1, while human pull-request approvals are recorded in `refs/notes/provenance`. During final muxing, the manifest—including human intent bindings and financial proofs—is injected into the MP4 or PDF/X-1a container as **C2PA metadata**. Because C2PA manifests can be stripped if a file is re-exported and rely on external certificate trust lists (whose signing keys must reside in the control plane, never inside an untrusted agent VM), the studio treats C2PA as an *additional* transport assertion alongside the authoritative content-addressed `render_manifest.json`.

### 4. Bidirectional Provenance Auditing: Part I — Backward Forensic Traces

Formalizing the production pipeline as a bidirectional DAG allows operators to interrogate any delivered artifact backward from **Final Media Plate $\longrightarrow$ Root Canon** to answer: *"Why does this specific pixel, audio wave, belief, or dollar charge exist?"*

```text
================================================================================
         FOUR-VECTOR BACKWARD FORENSIC AUDIT (MEDIA ──► ROOT CANON)
================================================================================

  [ DELIVERED MASTER MP4 (Frame 412 / Frame 144) ]
         │
         ├──► 1. VISUAL & SOMATIC TRACE:
         │       Frame 412 ──► Shot 03 ──► Exposure Sheet ──► Audio Stem (.wav)
         │       ──► AST Beat ──► Somatic Vector ──► Event Log ──► Canon Commit
         │       * Isolates: Axis A Compiler Failure vs. Axis B Diffusion Drift
         │
         ├──► 2. EPISTEMIC & BELIEF TRACE (WorldTruth != Belief != Utterance):
         │       Spoken Utterance ──► Plan-Assigned Act ──► Internal Belief 
         │       ──► parent_belief_id / source_event_id ──► Temporal Contact Graph
         │       (Co-presence Tick 12 -> Tick 18) ──► Originating Physical Event
         │
         ├──► 3. FINANCIAL COMBUSTION TRACE (org.freedominfra.financial_settlement):
         │       Frame 144 ──► render_manifest.json ──► Shot 02 Plate ($0.084 GPU)
         │       + Voice Stem ($0.00 CPU) + LLM Task ($0.0214) ──► idempotency_key
         │       ──► Patron Ledger Attribution (Stripe ID / Unspent Escrow Pool)
         │
         └──► 4. AUTONOMOUS CODE & PROMPT TRACE (Dual-Purpose Provenance):
                 Compiled Binary / TSX ──► CAS Squash Merge SHA ──► *.gravity.md /
                 *.jules.md Directive ──► Authoring Human vs. Agent Diff Audit
================================================================================

```

#### 1. Visual, Somatic & Acoustic Backward Trace (Fault Axis Isolation)

When an operator or VLM auditor flags a visual or acoustic anomaly in Episode 040 (e.g., Bog walking without a limp in Frame 412, exhibiting a scarred eye, or mouth visemes detaching/drifting $>80\text{ ms}$ from speech), the engine traverses the immutable hash chain backward:

$$\text{Frame 412} \longrightarrow \text{Shot 03} \longrightarrow \text{Exposure Sheet} \longrightarrow \text{Audio Stem SHA-256} \longrightarrow \text{AST Beat} \longrightarrow \text{Somatic Vector} \longrightarrow \text{Event Log} \longrightarrow \text{Canon Constraint}$$

Paired with grounded optical verification (`<visual_scan_trace>` in Jules Tier 3 VLM auditing and Mean Absolute Difference pixel volatility sampling $V_t = \frac{1}{W \times H}\sum_{x,y} \vert{}I(x,y,t) - I(x,y,t+1)\vert{}$), the backward audit deterministically classifies the defect into the **Cartesian Diagnostic Taxonomy** at $T_0 = \$0.00$:

* **Axis A (Semantic Compilation Failure):** The somatic invariant filter failed to block a banned kinetic verb or failed to emit negative prompt conditioning tokens, or an epistemic context leak occurred ($\text{Context}_{\text{char}}$).


* **Axis A (Temporal Quantization Failure):** Dialogue finishes 2 frames out of sync with mouth closure due to a rounding offset error in $\lceil (D_{\text{ms}}/1000) \times 24 \rceil$ between the audio timebase and frame clock.


* **Axis A (Visual Layout Failure):** A viseme detaches from a character's chin due to an asset `manifest.json` anchor-point coordinate mismatch against the canvas layout.


* **Axis B (Representation / Hardening Failure):** Upstream semantic conditioning was 100% valid, but the ComfyUI diffusion sampler drifted, a headless Chromium `--gl=swangle` container suffered an OOM or missing font glyph reflow, an unpinned shared viewport dependency caused a **Runtime Player Trap**, or MP4 container muxing timestamps altered the binary hash.



#### 2. Epistemic Backward Trace (Auditing Secrets & Rumor Chains)

Because the architecture enforces $\text{WorldTruth} \neq \text{Belief} \neq \text{Utterance}$, the Provenance Graph extends into character psychology to answer: *"How did Wart learn this secret?"*

* Rather than storing a flat boolean (`bog.knows["stolen_brass"] = true`), every belief record carries a `source_event_id` and `parent_belief_id`.


* The backward trace walks the **Temporal Contact Graph**, verifying the exact chain of co-presence ticks (e.g., Character 0 witnessed `source_event_id` in Episode 2, occupied an adjacent hex with Character 1 at Tick 12, who occupied an adjacent hex with Wart at Tick 18). If no unbroken chain of co-presence or sensory perception links the utterance to the originating event, the system flags an epistemic breach.



#### 3. Backward Financial Provenance Audit ("The Combustion Ledger")

Under the axiom that **financial cost is an immutable property of artifact provenance**, the Granular Per-Scene Production Invoice Modal ingests execution receipts from **POD-12 (System Middleware)** (`ShotCoordinatorDO` WebSocket runtimes, RunPod GPU milliseconds, Worker token counters) and reconciles them with **POD-03 (Production Finance)** (`burn_summary_YYYYMMDD.json` and Series Escrow Vault pools) before stamping the invoice into `render_manifest.json` and C2PA header `org.freedominfra.financial_settlement`.

An auditor or backer on the **Proof-of-Combustion Fuel Deck** can query any single frame (e.g., `Frame 144`) backward to inspect:

* **Compute Breakdown:** Shot 02 Diffusion Plate on RTX 4090 ($70.0\text{s} \text{ @ } \$0.00012/\text{sec} = 84{,}000\,\mu\text{USD}$), AST Line 001 Voice Synthesis on local Rig 1 CosyVoice ($0\,\mu\text{USD}$), and LLM Dialogue Scripting with 94.2% cached token hit rate ($21{,}400\,\mu\text{USD}$).


* **Patron Attribution & Double-Billing Detection:** Links the exact expenditure to the patron's Stripe inflow allocation (`patron_austin_tx_01`), displays remaining unspent escrow, and cross-checks the task's `idempotency_key` against Cloudflare D1 to guarantee the compute charge was never double-settled across prior scenes.

### 5. Bidirectional Provenance Auditing: Part II — Forward Blast-Radius Calculus & Transmedia Governance

Walking the Provenance DAG in the opposite direction—from **Root Canon $\longrightarrow$ Downstream Media**—powers the **Forward Blast-Radius Engine (`sower why-dirty <entity_id>`)**, allowing showrunners to answer *"If Fact $X$ changes upstream, what breaks downstream and what will it cost?"* at compile time ($T_0 = \$0.00$) before committing an edit.

#### A. Mathematical Multigraph Formalization & Centrality Taxonomy

The narrative universe is parameterized as a typed dependency multigraph $G_{\text{ref}} = (V_{\text{ent}}, E_{\text{dep}})$, where every downstream scene seals a cryptographic fingerprint of its consumed dependencies:

$$\text{SceneHash} = \mathcal{H}\left(\text{AST} + \sum_{i=1}^{k} \mathcal{H}(\text{Dependency}_i) + \text{Assets} + \text{CompilerVersion}\right)$$

Because Pass 2 compilation enforces Depth-First Search (DFS) three-color cycle detection on every commit, circular dependencies ($A \to B \to C \to A$) and the **Calcification Feedback Loop** are mathematically impossible, guaranteeing that every forward invalidation sweep terminates in finite time. For any node $v \in V_{\text{ent}}$, the engine computes the **Transitive Invalidation Blast Radius**:

$$R_{\text{blast}}(v) = \frac{\vert{}\mathcal{I}(v)\vert{}}{n}$$

where $\mathcal{I}(v)$ is the set of all downstream entities reachable via reverse dependency edges from $v$. Nodes are classified by their in-degree centrality ($k_{\text{in}}$) and reachability:

* **Dead Lore ($k_{\text{in}} \le 1$):** Unreferenced background data targeted for pruning.


* **Satellite Asset ($2 \le k_{\text{in}} \le 4$):** Holds localized dramatic context.


* **Balanced Hub ($5 \le k_{\text{in}} < \text{Spine}$):** A stable recurring narrative anchor.


* **Monolithic Spine / Critical Invalidation Hazard ($R_{\text{blast}}(v) > 0.40$):** Exceeds `max_transitive_blast_radius_ratio`, meaning a mutation invalidates $>40\%$ of the entire story bible; standard compilation halts and requires explicit human showrunner authorization.



#### B. Recursive CTE Execution & The "Still Good" Reconsideration Protocol

When an author runs `sower why-dirty <entity_id>` from `apps/995.library` (or previews an edit in `goblin-dashboard`), the engine executes the bounded recursive SQL CTE (`src/hub/queries/downstream_blast_radius.sql`) over `scene_fact_dependencies` and `scenes` in Cloudflare D1 with a hard recursion depth ceiling of `dc.depth < 6`, seamlessly resolving both multi-parent and diamond dependency confluences.

To replace manual "canon review meetings," the **Epistemological Audit Engine** continuously ranks high-reach facts that have gone unreviewed using a logarithmic tension formula:

$$\text{Audit Priority Score} = \text{Days Since Reconsideration} \times \log_{10}(\text{Downstream Dependent Scenes} + 1)$$

When an unresolved mystery or monolithic spine exceeds 60 days without evaluation, it surfaces in the Showrunner Cockpit. If the fact requires no changes, the showrunner clicks **"Still Good"**, which updates `last_reconsidered_at` in D1 without incrementing the fact version—resetting the audit priority score at $\$0.00$ compute cost without triggering false $H_{\text{dep}}$ churn or invalidating downstream rendered media.

#### C. Transmedia X-Trigger Propagation & Asymmetric Gate Resolution

When an upstream mutation is committed (transitioning $H_{\text{root}}(\text{old}) \longrightarrow H_{\text{root}}(\text{new})$), the **Transmedia X-Trigger Engine** pushes active invalidation notifications across all three canonical Medium Projection Spokes—the **Video Adapter ($R_v$)**, the **Comic Adapter ($R_c$)**, and the **Prose Adapter ($R_p$)**—resolving the blast radius asymmetrically based on each spoke's current commitment gate:

| Commitment Tier | Spoke Operational Status | Deterministic X-Trigger Engine Response |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Gate A (Pre-Compute — $T_1$)**<br> | Static screenplay drafting, local AST compilation, or Typst layout.

 | **Zero-Cost Cache Invalidation (`is_dirty = 1`):** Drops local AST/Typst caches and re-evaluates SAT constraints at **$\$0.00$ financial cost**.

 |
| **Gate B (Pre-Render — $T_2$)**<br> | Active rendering jobs dispatched to remote GPUs or foundation model APIs.

 | **Emergency GPU Circuit Breaker Trip:** Immediately terminates in-flight remote jobs to halt further capital burn, logs sunk compute spend in the scene invoice, and routes the ticket to the showrunner console.

 |
| **Past Gate C (Post-Release — $T_5$)**<br> | Public video streams distributed, ISBNs assigned, or physical print runs shipped.

 | **The Hard Retcon Firewall:** Refuses in-place database rewrites. Enforces the **Append-Only Errata Protocol**, distinguishing digital **Historical Preservation Mode** (`$0.00` spend, locked to original `canon_version`) vs. **Remastering Mode** (applying schema migration adapters $\mu_{v1 \to v2}$ to compile `Episode_040_Remaster.mp4` while preserving the original in cold storage) vs. physical print **Errata Sheets**.

 |

#### D. The Three Operator Remediation Pathways & Cold Audit Drainage

For scenes flagged `is_dirty = 1` prior to Gate C, the **Transmedia Canon Reconciliation Suite** presents the director with three deterministic remediation levers:

1. **Pathway 1: Re-Sync & Surgical Infill Patch (`[ RE-SYNC & INFILL REWRITE ]`):** Isolates the **Asymmetric Minimal Enclosing Unit (MEU)**—scanning backward to lock the preceding context as an immutable **Frozen Prefix** without expanding the rewrite window, and scanning forward to include only downstream beats that actively reference the mutated entity. Provided the expanded repair span remains $\le 40\%$ of the scene (beyond which automated repair aborts and escalates to a human review gate) and passes syntactic tense and coreference seam gates, the localized patch is spliced into the AST, resetting `is_dirty = 0` without re-rendering unaffected shots.


2. **Pathway 2: Full Step 1 Script & Animatic Re-Compilation (`[ FORCE RE-COMPILE SCRIPT ]`):** When the upstream change alters the structural premise of the scene (e.g., an actor is relocated to another room), the scene returns to Stage 1 (`produceEpisode.ts` on Rig 1), re-drafting the AST, re-synthesizing 48 kHz WAV stems on port `8000`, re-quantizing `ffprobe` frame counts, and rendering a fresh `--gl=swangle` CPU animatic for sign-off in `RemotionPlayerIsland.tsx`.


3. **Pathway 3: Dispute Upstream Mutation (`[ DISPUTE UPSTREAM MUTATION ]`):** Opens the **Retcon Blast-Radius Audit Desk** in `DirectorConsole.tsx`, allowing the showrunner to reject an erroneous upstream commit, execute an atomic rollback in `CANON_DB` to restore the original somatic/logistical vectors, and automatically clear `is_dirty = 0` across all dependent scenes with zero asset loss.



Finally, every directive run, MEU repair, CAS squash merge, and provenance audit recorded in the **Cloudflare D1 Hot Ledger** (`directive_runs` and `audit_events`) is swept at **midnight UTC (`00:00 UTC`)** by the **Cold Plaintext Drainage** daemon. Settled records are formatted into newline-delimited JSON (`.ndjson`), linked into a tamper-evident SHA-256 hash chain ($H_0 \to H_1 \to \dots \to H_n$), committed to the orphaned `audit-log` Git branch in `000.repo-bot`, and exposed for real-time inspection inside the **Blessed Flight Deck Audit Console** (`98.menu.unit` / `83.console.unit` `cns00`).

* Prioritize mandatory early enforcement on the two foundational fields—**who approved it** and **which canon version it used**—to answer whether an object was sanctioned and whether it remains valid without incurring premature maintenance overhead across minor objects.
