### 5. Preventing the Archival & Retrieval Dumpster Vault: Repo Scoping & HTGR

Even after research and lore are organized, poor repository boundaries and naive vector retrieval can turn the knowledge base itself into a secondary Dumpster Vault:

| Retrieval / Storage Pathology | Failure Mechanism | Deterministic Architectural Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **1. The Global Omnibus "Catch-All Junk Drawer"**<br> | Lumping *Under the Floorboards* goblin psychology into the same global store as *Wiregrass Basin*, Remotion OpenGL flags, or 50 GB of multi-series 3D `.glb` meshes causes cross-reality leakage, artificial tag-churn, and Git LFS quota exhaustion.

 | **Repo-Scoped Study Desks (*Il Fondo Documentale*):** In *Il Retroscena* (`/backstage/library`), `La Biblioteca del Drammaturgo` and `[series]-assets-3d` are strictly scoped per sovereign repository and dedicated series GitHub organization (`astro-kahn-it-com`, `wiregrass-basin`).

 |
| **2. The Multi-Draft Conflation Trap (NotebookLM)**<br> | Letting loose prose from older and newer drafts co-exist inside NotebookLM causes semantic retrieval to hallucinate conflicting assertions across timeline versions.

 | **3-Class Stratified Synchronization:** The dashboard synchronizes three strict document classes into NotebookLM: the **Constitutional Core** (immutable), **Dynamic Character Dossiers** (replaced in-place after each episode), and the **Chronological Historical Ledger** (append-only).

 |
| **3. Vector Drift & The RAG Poisoning Trap**<br> | Searching 1,000,000 raw lore vectors by embedding similarity alone is slow, expensive, and noisy—querying *"Silas enters a tavern"* in Chapter 32 pulls bar scenes from Chapters 4, 11, and 19, flooding prompts with dead characters and resolved arguments.

 | **Hybrid Temporal-Graph Retrieval (HTGR):** Embeddings in `LoreDO` are never queried raw; critical tags (`world_timestamp`, `location_id` / `location_scope`, `active_characters`, `dead_characters`, `family_name`, `sin_type`, `secrecy_level`) are promoted to vector metadata to filter deterministically *before* semantic search (reducing 1,000,000 fragments to 100 relevant vectors).

 |
| **4. The Silent Prison of Stale Canon**<br> | Early throwaway facts committed under deadline pressure compound their in-degree centrality ($k_{\text{in}} = 1 \to 12 \to 45$) without ever throwing downward linter errors, calcifying the storyworld.

 | **The "Still Good" Reconsideration Protocol:** Ranks unreviewed high-reach facts via $\text{Audit Priority Score} = \text{Days Since Reconsideration} \times \log_{10}(\text{Downstream Dependent Scenes} + 1)$ and surfaces them after 60 days for a $\$0.00$ `"Still Good"` re-affirmation in D1.

 |

 ### Feature 3.1: The 5th Pacing Mode Gate (`SHARED_RECOGNITION` / `IRONIC_RECKONING`) — Extreme-Detail Architectural Specification

Within **EPIC 3 (Shared-Recognition Pacing & Subtext Ratification Cockpit)** in `goblin-dashboard`, **Feature 3.1** resolves a foundational structural asymmetry in the pipeline's epistemic architecture. While the **Hitchcock Epistemic Matrix** explicitly defines four quadrants of audience-versus-character awareness—culminating in **`SHARED RECOGNITION` (Direct confrontation, catharsis, status shifts)** when both the audience and the interacting characters know the truth ($\text{Audience Knows} = \text{YES} \land \text{Character Knows} = \text{YES}$)—the underlying TypeScript union `DramaticPacingMode` in `epistemicAudience.ts` originally implemented only four modes: `'DRAMATIC_IRONY' | 'SUSPENSE' | 'SURPRISE' | 'MYSTERY'`.

Even more critically, the existing compile-time verification gate in `pacingGates.ts` treated `SHARED_RECOGNITION` purely as an illegal failure state of `DRAMATIC_IRONY`, throwing a fatal exception whenever an interacting actor gained awareness of the central proposition:

> `[PACING GATE FAILURE: DRAMATIC_IRONY] Interacting actor holds verified belief of '${focalPropositionId}'. Irony collapsed into Shared Recognition.`
> 

Because the compiler lacked a formal 5th mode to govern that collapse, the engine could withhold secrets (`MYSTERY`, `DRAMATIC_IRONY`), tick time-bound hazards (`SUSPENSE`), and trigger sudden shocks (`SURPRISE`), but could not legally compile the climactic **Anagnorisis / Peripeteia** moment where sustained dramatic irony resolves into mutual, inescapable reckoning.

---

### 1. Epistemic Invariants & The Complete 5-Mode Hitchcock Matrix

By elevating **`SHARED_RECOGNITION` (`IRONIC_RECKONING`)** into a first-class compilation contract, the pipeline completes the state-transition lifecycle of a canonical fact ($\Phi$) across the season runway ($\delta = 0 \to \delta_{\max}$):

| Mode Identifier | Audience Aware? ($\Phi \in \text{revealed\_facts}$) | Character Aware? ($\Phi \in \text{Actor}.\mathcal{K}$) | Primary Dramatic Sensation & Structural Function |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **`DRAMATIC_IRONY`** | **YES**<br> | **NO** (`TOTAL_IGNORANCE` / `FALSE_BELIEF`)

 | Generates persistent dread, conversational tension, and voyeuristic anticipation as characters act on false premises.

 |
| **`SUSPENSE`** | **YES**<br> | **NO** (Time-Bound Hazard Pending)

 | Generates acute anxiety via an active ticking clock ($\exists H_{\text{hazard}}: T_{\text{trigger}} - T_{\text{current}} \le \Delta t_{\text{threshold}}$) while characters converse routinely.

 |
| **`MYSTERY`** | **NO** ($\Phi \in \text{withheld\_secrets}$)

 | **YES** (`WITHHELD` / `FACTUAL_WITNESS`)

 | Generates curiosity, analytical suspicion, and forensic deduction while scrubbing core lemmas via `banned_attenuation_tokens`.

 |
| **`SURPRISE`** | **NO** (at $T_0$) $\to$ **YES** (at $T_1$)

 | **NO** (at $T_0$) $\to$ **YES** (at $T_1$)

 | Symmetrical ignorance transitioning atomically into symmetrical awareness; triggers immediate visceral shock and screen jolt.

 |
| **`SHARED_RECOGNITION`** (`IRONIC_RECKONING`) | **YES** (Exposed prior to $T_0$)

 | **YES** (Both interacting actors hold verified belief)

 | **Symmetrical Awareness:** Information management collapses into direct interpersonal conflict, status shifts, callback boomerangs, and catharsis.

 |

```text
          THE SEASONAL EPISTEMIC STATE-TRANSITION FUNNEL
          
  [ MYSTERY ] (Ep 1–3)             [ SURPRISE ] (Mid-Season Turn)
  • Audience: NO | Actor A: YES    • Audience: NO -> YES | Actor: NO -> YES
         │                                        │
         ▼ Audience witnesses Φ on-screen         ▼ Actor B remains blind
  [ DRAMATIC_IRONY / SUSPENSE ] (Ep 4–10)
  • Audience: YES (revealed_facts)
  • Actor A: WITHHELD | Actor B: TOTAL_IGNORANCE (+ Decoy Anchor D_decoy)
         │
         ▼ L_1 Carrier Prop betrays Actor A / Actor B acquires FACTUAL_WITNESS
  [ SHARED_RECOGNITION / IRONIC_RECKONING ] (Ep 11–12 Climax, δ >= 2)
  • Audience: YES ∧ Actor A: YES ∧ Actor B: YES
  • Unlocks Callback Boomerang + 192-Frame (-24 dB) Post-Recognition Hold

```

### 2. Task 3.1.1: Schema Architecture & TypeScript Contract Extensions (`epistemicAudience.ts`)

**Target Workspace & Files:** `packages/001.lore/schemas/epistemicAudience.ts` (mirrored in `src/schemas/epistemicAudience.ts` and shared via npm workspaces across `000.goblin-lore`, `worker-sower-engine`, and `goblin-dashboard`).

To support **Task 3.1.1** and **Task 3.1.4**, the closed Zod schema contracts are extended to include `'SHARED_RECOGNITION'` inside `DramaticPacingModeEnum`, alongside a strongly typed `EpistemicManifestSchema` that seals the exact transition history into approved scene metadata:

```typescript
// packages/001.lore/schemas/epistemicAudience.ts
import { z } from 'zod';

export const ExposureTypeEnum = z.enum([
  'EXPLICIT_ON_SCREEN',  // Fact directly witnessed visually or spoken in dialogue
  'IMPLIED_SUBTEXTUAL',  // Heavy circumstantial evidence presented to viewer
  'FORENSIC_DOCUMENT',   // Visible in-universe prop, stamped blueprint, or ledger
]);
export type ExposureType = z.infer<typeof ExposureTypeEnum>;

export const RevealedFactEnvelopeSchema = z.object({
  revealed_in_episode: z.string().regex(/^ep\d+$/),
  revealed_in_scene: z.string().regex(/^ep\d+_sc\d+$/),
  exposure_type: ExposureTypeEnum,
  visibility_hash: z.string().length(64), // SHA-256 digest of revealing shot
  timestamp_epoch: z.number().int().positive(),
}).strict();
export type RevealedFactEnvelope = z.infer<typeof RevealedFactEnvelopeSchema>;

export const AudienceKnowledgeStateSchema = z.object({
  revealed_facts: z.record(
    z.string().regex(/^(mystery|fact)_[a-z0-9_]+$/),
    RevealedFactEnvelopeSchema
  ),
  withheld_secrets: z.array(z.string().regex(/^mystery_[a-z0-9_]+$/)),
}).strict();
export type AudienceKnowledgeState = z.infer<typeof AudienceKnowledgeStateSchema>;

// TASK 3.1.1: Extended 5-Mode Pacing Union completing the Hitchcock Matrix
export const DramaticPacingModeEnum = z.enum([
  'DRAMATIC_IRONY',     // Audience: YES | Character: NO (Dread & voyeuristic tension)
  'SUSPENSE',           // Audience: YES | Character: NO + Time-bound physical hazard
  'SURPRISE',           // Audience: NO->YES | Character: NO->YES (Simultaneous shock)
  'MYSTERY',            // Audience: NO  | Character: YES (Cryptic clues, attenuation)
  'SHARED_RECOGNITION', // Audience: YES | Character: YES (Ironic reckoning & catharsis)
]);
export type DramaticPacingMode = z.infer<typeof DramaticPacingModeEnum>;

// TASK 3.1.4: Immutable Epistemic Provenance Manifest stamped on scene approval
export const EpistemicManifestSchema = z.object({
  scene_id: z.string().regex(/^ep\d+_sc\d+$/),
  focal_proposition_id: z.string().regex(/^(mystery|fact)_[a-z0-9_]+$/),
  active_pacing_mode: DramaticPacingModeEnum,
  prior_pacing_mode: DramaticPacingModeEnum.optional(),
  audience_exposure_ref: RevealedFactEnvelopeSchema.optional(),
  actor_horizon_snapshot: z.record(
    z.string(),
    z.enum([
      'TOTAL_IGNORANCE',
      'RUMOR_ONLY',
      'FALSE_BELIEF',
      'PARTIAL_FACT',
      'WITHHELD',
      'FACTUAL_WITNESS',
    ])
  ),
  callback_boomerang_ids: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
  post_recognition_hold_frames: z.number().int().min(0).max(240).default(0),
  manifest_sha256: z.string().length(64),
}).strict();
export type EpistemicManifest = z.infer<typeof EpistemicManifestSchema>;

```

### 3. Task 3.1.2: Compile-Time Verification Gate (`pacingGates.ts`) at $T_0 = \$0.00$

**Target Workspace & Files:** `goblin-dashboard/src/lib/compilers/pacingGates.ts` and `packages/001.lore/src/compiler.ts`.

In a programmatic media pipeline where neural speech synthesis, video diffusion plates, and headless Chromium renders burn real capital, broken dramatic pacing must fail closed in local RAM at **Stage $T_0 = \$0.00$**. **Task 3.1.2** upgrades the predicate verification table and adds the `'SHARED_RECOGNITION'` branch to `verifyPacingCompilationGate()`:

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│             PACING MODE COMPILATION VERIFICATION GATES (T_0 = $0.00)    │
├──────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Mode Declared        │ Predicate Logic Verification Rule                │

│                      │ Φ ∉ Actor.BeliefRecords ∧                        │

├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ SUSPENSE             │ Φ ∈ revealed_facts ∧                             │
│                      │ Φ ∉ Actor.BeliefRecords ∧                        │
│                      │ PendingHazard(Φ).is_time_bound == true           │
├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ SURPRISE             │ Φ ∉ revealed_facts (at T_0) ∧                    │
│                      │ Φ ∉ Actor.BeliefRecords (at T_0) ∧               │
│                      │ Φ ∈ revealed_facts (at T_1)                      │
├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

│                      │ Actor.EpistemicHorizon ∈ {WITHHELD, WITNESS}     │
├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ SHARED_RECOGNITION   │ Φ ∈ revealed_facts (at T_0) ∧                    │
│ (IRONIC_RECKONING)   │ ∀ a ∈ SceneActors: Φ ∈ a.BeliefRecords ∧         │
│                      │ δ(ActiveGrievance) >= min_grievance_depth (2) ∧  │
│                      │ SelfForgedTrap(TargetActor, Φ) == true           │
└──────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

```

#### Concrete Gate Implementation (`verifyPacingCompilationGate`)

When the showrunner stages a scene in `SHARED_RECOGNITION`, the compiler executes four sequential zero-cost assertions:

1. **Prior Audience Exposure Assertion ($\Phi \in \text{revealed\_facts}$):** Verifies that `audienceState.revealed_facts[focalPropositionId]` exists prior to $T_0$. If the audience is learning the secret at the exact same moment as the characters, the scene is structurally a `SURPRISE`, not a `SHARED_RECOGNITION` catharsis, and the gate halts compilation.


2. **Mutual Actor Belief Assertion ($\forall a \in \text{Actors}: \Phi \in a.\text{BeliefRecords}$):** Verifies that both the speaker (`Actor A`, who previously held `WITHHELD` standing) and the interlocutor (`Actor B`, who previously held `TOTAL_IGNORANCE` or `FALSE_BELIEF` $> 5{,}000\text{ bp}$) now hold verified belief records (`FACTUAL_WITNESS` or `WITHHELD`) for $\Phi$. If `actorKnows === false`, the gate throws a fatal error directing the operator back to `DRAMATIC_IRONY`.


3. **Topological Escalation Runway Check ($\delta \ge \text{min\_grievance\_depth}$):** Cross-checks the active grievance against Pillar 3's `PREMATURE_CLIMAX` and `SHALLOW_CANON` thresholds in `series.config.json` (`min_grievance_depth: 2`, `min_climactic_intensity_ceiling: 4`). This prevents a director from firing `SHARED_RECOGNITION` on a $\delta = 0$ root dispute in Episode 1 before dramatic irony has accumulated.


4. **The "Chekhov's Ledger" Self-Forged Trap Query:** For any climax resolution at `narrative_depth >= 2`, the compiler queries Cloudflare D1 / SQLite to verify that the `fact_id` exposing or defeating `target_actor_id` was originally authored by that same actor's defensive `INTENT` in an earlier episode (`e.initiating_actor_id = r.target_actor_id`), guaranteeing that the reversal is self-inflicted irony rather than random coincidence.



```typescript
// goblin-dashboard/src/lib/compilers/pacingGates.ts
export function verifyPacingCompilationGate(
  targetPacingMode: DramaticPacingMode,
  focalPropositionId: string,
  audienceState: AudienceKnowledgeState,
  actorBeliefIds: readonly string[],
  interlocutorBeliefIds: readonly string[],
  grievanceDepth: number,
  minGrievanceDepth = 2
): void {
  const audienceKnows = Boolean(audienceState.revealed_facts[focalPropositionId]);
  const speakerKnows = actorBeliefIds.includes(focalPropositionId);
  const interlocutorKnows = interlocutorBeliefIds.includes(focalPropositionId);

  switch (targetPacingMode) {
    case 'DRAMATIC_IRONY': {
      if (!audienceKnows) {
        throw new Error(
          `[PACING GATE FAILURE: DRAMATIC_IRONY] Proposition '${focalPropositionId}' ` +
          `has not been witnessed by the audience. Irony requires prior audience exposure.`
        );
      }
      if (speakerKnows && interlocutorKnows) {
        throw new Error(
          `[PACING GATE FAILURE: DRAMATIC_IRONY] Interacting actors both hold verified belief ` +
          `of '${focalPropositionId}'. Irony collapsed into Shared Recognition. ` +
          `Switch mode to 'SHARED_RECOGNITION'.`
        );
      }
      break;
    }

    case 'SHARED_RECOGNITION': {
      if (!audienceKnows) {
        throw new Error(
          `[PACING GATE FAILURE: SHARED_RECOGNITION] Proposition '${focalPropositionId}' ` +
          `is absent from revealed_facts. Shared Recognition requires prior audience awareness; ` +
          `use 'SURPRISE' for simultaneous revelation.`
        );
      }
      if (!speakerKnows || !interlocutorKnows) {
        throw new Error(
          `[PACING GATE FAILURE: SHARED_RECOGNITION] Asymmetrical actor horizons detected ` +
          `for '${focalPropositionId}' (Speaker=${speakerKnows}, Interlocutor=${interlocutorKnows}). ` +
          `Shared Recognition requires mutual awareness across interacting actors.`
        );
      }
      if (grievanceDepth < minGrievanceDepth) {
        throw new Error(
          `[PACING GATE FAILURE: PREMATURE_CLIMAX] Cannot trigger SHARED_RECOGNITION at ` +
          `grievance depth δ=${grievanceDepth} (min_grievance_depth=${minGrievanceDepth}).`
        );
      }
      break;
    }
  }
}

```

#### B. The 3-Column Epistemic Horizon Panopticon (`EpistemicAuditPanel.tsx`)

Mounted on `src/pages/telemetry/epistemic.astro`, the 3-column split view audits **Column 1: Audience Reality (`revealed_facts`)**, **Column 2: Speaker Bubble (`Actor A`)**, and **Column 3: Interlocutor Bubble (`Actor B`)**:

* **Pre-Flight Tripwire Enforcement:** If a showrunner selects `SHARED_RECOGNITION` while either `Actor A` or `Actor B` still has `TOTAL_IGNORANCE` in their horizon bubble, `EpistemicAuditPanel.tsx` illuminates a flashing crimson alert: `ASYMMETRIC_ACTOR_HORIZON` (or `MISSING_AUDIENCE_EXPOSURE` if the audience ledger lacks the fact) and locks the `[ DISPATCH STAGE 3 DRAFT ]` button.


* **Horizon Re-Anchoring Escape Hatch:** If the showrunner realizes during pre-flight inspection that `SHARED_RECOGNITION` is firing too early in the season, they can click the **Horizon Re-Anchoring** override inside Column 3 to force `Actor B` back to `TOTAL_IGNORANCE` (re-binding their `pragmatic_decoy_anchor`), which automatically switches the legal pacing mode back to `DRAMATIC_IRONY`.

### 5. Task 3.1.4: Provenance Stamping & Downstream Multi-Modal Compilation Coupling

Once `SHARED_RECOGNITION` (`IRONIC_RECKONING`) passes the $T_0 = \$0.00$ verification gate, the mode stamps an immutable `epistemic_manifest` into the scene metadata and compiles deterministic instructions across all three downstream execution clusters:

```text
                  SHARED_RECOGNITION (IRONIC_RECKONING)
                                    │
      ┌─────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────┐
      ▼                             ▼                             ▼
worker-sower-engine        audio-microservice          goblin-viewport-template
• Deactivates Decoy D_decoy • Somatic Fatigue (Π_eff)   • 3-Part Timeline Split
• L_1 Carrier Prop Betrayal • 192f (8.0s) TTS Bypass    • 192f post_roll_frames
• Callback Boomerang Quote  • -24 dB Dead-Air Vacuum    • Slow Push-In + Stillness
• S >= 0.85 Subtext Clamp   • Zero Score Swell Bleed    • C2PA & epistemic_manifest

```

#### 1. `worker-sower-engine` (Stage 3 Prompt Compiler & 15/70/15 Attention Sandwich)

* **Deactivation of the Pragmatic Decoy Hijack:** In `DRAMATIC_IRONY`, `contextAssembly.ts` injected `[PRAGMATIC INTERPRETATION DIRECTIVE]` into the top 15% primacy zone of Envelope B so the ignorant actor would misattribute every hesitation to a petty surface dispute (e.g., `grievance_missing_brass_washers`). Transitioning to `SHARED_RECOGNITION` strips the decoy hijack and aligns both actors on the verified proposition $\Phi$.


* **Partial-Flattening of the Attenuation Filter (Preventing the Cheesy Monologue):** Even though both characters now know the truth, `SHARED_RECOGNITION` **does not lift `banned_attenuation_tokens` to allow on-the-nose moralizing**. Instead, Subtext Suppression remains clamped ($S \ge 0.85$) while the **$L_1$ Tactical Displacement Prop physically breaks, jams, or betrays the speaker** on stage, making the verbal lie impossible to maintain without a single line of melodramatic exposition. If a candidate take still leaks a forbidden emotional confession, flagging it with `UNEARNED_RELEASE` in `SceneReviewGate.tsx` appends the leaked lemma to the attenuation mask and triggers a ~150-token **Asymmetric Minimal Enclosing Unit (MEU)** surgical infill pass.


* **Callback Boomerang Injection:** The prompt compiler queries `JournalDO` / `canon_facts` for the highest-salience `callback_phrases` the protagonist used to deflect or dominate in Episodes 1–3, and injects them into the bottom 15% recency zone of the interlocutor's prompt envelope—allowing the scene partner to hand the protagonist's exact defensive words back to them as the lie collapses.



#### 2. `audio-microservice` (Port 8000 Acoustic Master Clock & `SceneAudioBed.ts`)

* **Thermodynamic Fatigue Dilation ($\Pi_{\text{eff}}$):** Because `SHARED_RECOGNITION` occurs at peak Refusal Strain and Somatic Fatigue (`SOMATIC_FATIGUE_bps`), speech pauses are physically stretched via the thermodynamic dilation equation:

$$\Pi_{\text{eff}} = \Pi_{\text{base}} \times \left(1.0 + \frac{\text{SOMATIC\_FATIGUE}_{\text{bps}}}{10000} \times \kappa_{\text{exhaust}}\right)$$



expanding a resting 2,100 ms (51-frame) stem into a labored 3,850 ms (93-frame) delivery.


* **MRU Inverted Silence Allocation (The 192-Frame `-24 dB` Dead-Air Vacuum):** Whereas standard Dwight Swain MRU `VISCERAL_STING` cues inject 8 to 24 frames of silence *before* speech (`pre_roll_frames`), `SHARED_RECOGNITION` locks the episode's silence hold budget (`Hold? X`) **immediately after the callback line or prop betrayal lands**. The AST emits an explicit silence directive (`durationInFrames: 192` / `8.0 seconds` at 24.0 fps) that bypasses TTS synthesis and drives `AmbientTrack.tsx` down to a strict **`-24 dB` floor** (below the standard `-14 dB` dialogue sidechain ducking floor), creating an unbroken vacuum of dead air that prevents the LLM from explaining the joke or the tragedy.



#### 3. `goblin-viewport-template` (Remotion Optical Assembly & Provenance Sealing)

* **3-Part Timeline Decoupling (`exposure_sheet.json`):** The exposure sheet maps the recognition beat across the three decoupled integer segments:

$$\text{durationInFrames} = \text{pre\_roll\_frames} + \text{measured\_duration\_frames} + \text{post\_roll\_frames}$$



locking the 192-frame dead-air hold into `post_roll_frames` so the showrunner can scrub and verify the exact cut timing in `WaveformScrubber.tsx` and `RemotionPlayerIsland.tsx` (`--gl=swangle`, `--concurrency=1` at $T_0 = \$0.00$) in $\le 60\text{ seconds}$ before clicking **`AUTHORIZE CLOUD VIDEO BATCH`**.


* **Cryptographic Provenance Stamping:** Upon final approval and Level 3 Conformance Certification ($\text{SSIM} \ge 0.9999$, $\Delta E < 0.1$, 0 audio sample drift), the scene stamps the signed `epistemic_manifest` (recording the exact `DRAMATIC_IRONY` $\to$ `SHARED_RECOGNITION` transition) alongside the C2PA metadata manifest directly into the master MP4 container and seals the state transition into Cloudflare D1.

### Implementation Roadmap: Feature 3.1 (FEAT-PAC-03.1) — The 5th Pacing Mode Gate (`SHARED_RECOGNITION` / `IRONIC_RECKONING`)

In the generative production pipeline, `epistemicAudience.ts` originally modeled only four dramatic pacing modes (`DRAMATIC_IRONY`, `SUSPENSE`, `SURPRISE`, `MYSTERY`), treating the fourth quadrant of the Hitchcock Epistemic Matrix—where both the audience ($\Phi \in \text{revealed\_facts}$) and the interacting characters ($\Phi \in \text{Actor}.\mathcal{K}$) possess verified awareness of a central secret—strictly as an illegal failure state (`Irony collapsed into Shared Recognition`). **Feature 3.1** elevates **`SHARED_RECOGNITION` (`IRONIC_RECKONING`)** into a first-class compile-time verification gate at Stage $T_0 = \$0.00$, orchestrating the exact structural transition where sustained dramatic irony collapses into mutual recognition, callback boomerangs, and an unbroken post-recognition silence hold.

### Feature 3.2: Grievance DAG Steering & Deterministic Subtext Ratification — Extreme-Detail Architectural Specification

Within the generative production pipeline, **Feature 3.2: Grievance DAG Steering & Deterministic Subtext Ratification** forms the critical human-in-the-loop bridge between **Axis A (Semantic Meaning & World Law)** in `000.goblin-lore` / `worker-sower-engine` and **Axis B (Representation & Artifact Hardening)** in `goblin-dashboard`.

Left purely to autonomous execution, procedural narrative simulations succumb to two fatal failure modes:

1. **Macro-Pacing Entropy & Circular Bickering:** If interpersonal conflict is modeled as an unconstrained state machine ($A \to B \to C \to A$), stochastic lotteries trap characters in repetitive domestic loops, clustering high-friction pairs while starving secondary cast members.


2. **Exposition Bleed & Causality Drift:** When language models generate ungrounded emotional confessions ("on-the-nose" exposition) and human writers manually line-edit the resulting screenplay text, the generated media permanently desynchronizes from the relational simulation ledger.



Feature 3.2 eliminates both failure modes at zero marginal compute cost ($T_0 = \$0.00$) by pairing **Multi-Tier Grievance DAG Steering (`GrievanceDAGViewer.tsx`)** with **Closed-Taxonomy Deterministic Subtext Ratification (`SceneReviewGate.tsx`)**.

---

### 1. The Dual-Rail Grievance Contract & Corpus Architecture

Rather than allowing an LLM to improvise interpersonal drama at runtime, the simulation engine is fueled by a pre-authored corpus of **40 to 60 schema-validated grievances** distributed across **7 canonical thematic categories**: `resource_hoarding`, `status_anxiety`, `secret_keeping`, `generational_rift`, `territorial_boundary`, `loyalty_tests`, and `domestic_sabotage`. Every grievance operates as a loaded mechanical spring governed by the **Byte-0 Frontmatter Guarantee** (starting strictly at byte 0 with `---`, zero UTF-8 BOM bytes, and POSIX LF `0x0A` line endings) and bifurcated into two strict operational rails:

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   THE ANATOMY OF A GRIEVANCE SPRING                    │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1. THE MACHINE RAIL (Byte-0 YAML Frontmatter)                          │
│ • Deterministic ID (grv_*), category, & intensity_range [I_min, I_max] │
│ • Cooldown cycles (C_cycles) & decay_rate (fast | medium | slow | none)│
│ • Three-tier participant arrays (primary, can_involve, cannot_involve) │
│ • Required physical props (required_props) & spatial location_tags     │
│ • Directed causal edge: spawns_on_max_escalation ({ type, target_id }) │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 2. THE VOICE RAIL (Canonical Markdown Body)                            │
│ • Surface Complaint : The mundane proxy argued over (e.g., valve thread│
│                       or silver spoon grease)                          │
│ • The Underneath    : The existential wound, physical decline, or debt │
│ • Escalation Stages : 1 to 4 structured progression beats              │
│ • Callback Phrases  : Literal recurring verbal motifs                  │
│ • Tonal Override    : Boolean farce flag (tonal_override_eligible)     │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

```

* **The Machine Rail (Frontmatter):** Evaluated by `worker-sower-engine` using pure, deterministic set operations without natural-language heuristics:



$$\text{Eligible} = (\text{SceneCast} \cap \text{Primary}) \setminus \text{Excluded} \quad \text{where} \quad \text{Intensity} \in [I_{\min}, I_{\max}] \land \text{Cooldown} = 0$$



* **The Voice Rail (Markdown Body):** Selectively injected into drafting prompts to enforce psychological subtext, instructing the LLM to argue aggressively over the *Surface Complaint* while actively suppressing any direct statement of *The Underneath*.


* **Lifecycle Retirement & Succession:** When a grievance reaches its conclusion, the CLI retirement engine routes it through one of two pathways: **Direct Archival Migration** (moving the file to `corpus/grievances/_retired/` and setting `grievance_runtime_state` to `RESOLVED` so it exits candidate lotteries while preserving analytical history) or **Causal Mutation & Succession** (spawning a typed downstream `{ type: 'grievance' | 'secret', target_id: string }` entity when intensity hits Stage 4/5).



---

### 2. Mathematical Formalization & Compile-Time Verification of $\mathcal{G}_{\text{DAG}}$

All interpersonal friction is structured as a finite Directed Acyclic Graph ($\mathcal{G}_{\text{DAG}}$):


$$\mathcal{G}_{\text{DAG}} = (\mathcal{V}_{\text{grv}}, \, \mathcal{E}_{\text{spawn}}) \quad \text{where} \quad \forall v \in \mathcal{V}_{\text{grv}}, \; v \notin \text{Descendants}(v)$$

#### Confluent Diamond Escalation & Topological Depth ($\delta$)

An edge $(u, v) \in \mathcal{E}_{\text{spawn}}$ dictates that when Parent Grievance $u$ hits its maximum intensity ceiling ($I_{\text{curr}} = I_{\max}$) during a Stage 4 duel, it atomically promotes Child Grievance $v$ into the active pool. The graph organizes the season across topological depth ranks ($\delta_{\max} = \max_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \delta(g)$) and supports **Confluent Diamond Topologies**, where distinct micro-frictions merge into a single structural crisis and epistemic revelation:

* **Depth $\delta = 0$ (Root Micro-Frictions):** In-degree $k_{\text{in}} = 0$, low-intensity entry disputes ($I_{\min} \le 2$) such as `grv_silver_spoon_grease` (Bog vs. Spleen/Wart) and `grv_watch_rotation_slack` (Wart vs. Spleen).


* **Depth $\delta = 1$ (Intermediate Structural Crises):** Mid-season escalations such as `grv_hoarding_reveal` (Bog vs. Mum Grissel) and `grv_status_anxiety` (Wart vs. Bog).


* **Depth $\delta \ge 2$ (Terminal Climactic Sinks):** Out-degree $k_{\text{out}} = 0$ (for grievance transitions), where both $\delta = 1$ branches converge onto `grv_generational_famine_feud` (Mum Grissel vs. Bog), which upon maximum escalation spawns the canonical secret `sec_famine_well_poison`.


* **The Critical Pacing Path ($\Pi_{\text{crit}}$):** The maximal directed causal chain traversing $\delta = 0 \to 1 \to 2$, establishing the primary narrative spine of the season.



#### Pure Projection Accessor (`getActiveGrievanceDAG`)

Housed in `packages/001.lore/src/client.ts`, `getActiveGrievanceDAG(state: Readonly<BibleState>)` extracts the causal lattice from the compiled `bible-state.json` artifact:

1. **Polymorphic Target Normalization:** Converts three authored frontmatter formats—bare string literals (`"hoarding_reveal"`), structured target envelopes (`{ type: "grievance", target_id: "hoarding_reveal", threshold: 4 }`), and legacy object wrappers (`{ id: "hoarding_reveal" }`)—into a uniform `Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>` map.


2. **Defensive Nil-Coalescing & Deep-Freeze Sealing:** Missing `spawns_on_max_escalation` fields coalesce to `[]`, and the output is recursively sealed via `deepFreeze()` (`Object.freeze`), causing any accidental client-side mutation to throw an immediate `TypeError` in strict mode.


3. **Sub-Millisecond Complexity:** Performing zero disk I/O, regex parsing, or network calls, the accessor executes in $\mathcal{O}(\vert{}\mathcal{V}_{\text{grv}}\vert{} + \vert{}\mathcal{E}_{\text{spawn}}\vert{})$ time (`< 0.5 ms` on local V8 and Cloudflare Worker isolates) and is verified via Vitest in `packages/001.lore/test/client.test.ts`.



#### The 7 Compile-Time Defect Gates (`auditEscalationDag`)

Before `getActiveGrievanceDAG` can project state into `goblin-dashboard`, Pass 2 of the compiler runs `auditEscalationDag` in `packages/001.lore/src/health/escalationDag.ts` at $T_0 = \$0.00$:

| Defect Class | Severity | Formal Mathematical Invariant | System Action on Breach |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **1. `LORE_ESCALATION_CYCLE` (`CYCLE_DETECTED`)**<br> | **CRITICAL (FATAL)**<br> | Three-Color DFS: $\forall v \in \mathcal{V}_{\text{grv}}, \; v \notin \text{Descendants}(v)$<br> | **Hard Halt (Exit Code 1):** Aborts build and emits exact cycle trace to `stderr` (e.g., `grv_spoon_credit -> grv_hoarding_reveal -> grv_spoon_credit`).

 |
| **2. `LORE_PREMATURE_CLIMAX**`<br> | **CRITICAL (FATAL)**<br> | $(\delta(v) = 0) \implies (v.I_{\min} \le \text{max\_root\_intensity\_floor})$ (typically $\le 2$)

 | **Hard Halt:** Rejects $\delta = 0$ files with $I_{\min} \ge 3$, preventing relationship-destroying stakes on Episode 1.

 |
| **3. `SHALLOW_CANON**`<br> | **HIGH (WARN)**<br> | $\delta_{\max} \ge \text{config.min\_grievance\_depth}$ (minimum $\ge 2$)

 | **Advisory Warning:** Alerts authors that the corpus lacks sufficient multi-episode escalation runway.

 |
| **4. `ORPHAN_SPAWN_UNREACHABLE**`<br> | **CRITICAL (FATAL)**<br> | $u.\text{intensity\_ceiling} \ge u.\text{spawn\_threshold}$<br> | **Hard Halt:** Catches child nodes whose parent intensity bounds make spawning mathematically impossible.

 |
| **5. `UNRESOLVED_TERMINAL_SINK**`<br> | **MEDIUM (WARN)**<br> | $(k_{\text{out}}(v) = 0 \land v.I_{\max} \ge 4) \implies \vert{}\mathcal{R}_{\text{paths}}\vert{} > 0$<br> | **Advisory Warning:** Flags high-intensity terminal sinks lacking formal resolution off-ramps.

 |
| **6. `EXPLOSIVE_FAN_OUT**`<br> | **MEDIUM (WARN)**<br> | $k_{\text{out}}(u) \le \text{config.max\_branching\_factor}$ ($\le 3$)

 | **Advisory Warning:** Flags single nodes spawning $>3$ children to prevent unmanageable narrative divergence.

 |
| **7. `FARCE_CONTAMINATION_LEAK**`<br> | **CRITICAL (FATAL)**<br> | $\tau_{\text{farce}} \implies (k_{\text{out}} = 0 \land I_{\max} \le 2 \land \delta = 0) \land \text{Ratio}_{\text{tonal}} \le 0.15$<br> | **Hard Halt:** Forbids comedic palate cleansers (5–8 dossiers) from spawning existential feuds, exceeding Stage 2, or breaching the $15\%$ corpus cap, and requires *The Underneath* to declare *"There genuinely isn't an underneath; this is the point"*.

 |

The **Three-Color DFS** algorithm tracks vertices across three states in milliseconds: **WHITE (0 — Unvisited)**, **GRAY (1 — Active on the recursion stack)**, and **BLACK (2 — Fully traversed and verified acyclic)**. Any edge targeting a GRAY node immediately trips `LORE_ESCALATION_CYCLE` both in the CLI compiler and in the client-side DAG Builder UI.

### 3. Combinatorial Dyadic Mesh & Participant Role Differentiation

To guarantee that spatial encounters never deadlock at runtime, the health engine and dashboard cross-reference $\mathcal{G}_{\text{DAG}}$ against the cast's combinatorial dyadic mesh:

#### 1. Canonical Lexicographical Indexing & The Symmetric Incidence Matrix ($\mathbf{M}$)

To prevent directionality bugs ($A \to B$ vs. $B \to A$), character pairs are indexed via an order-independent key:


$$\text{Key}(u, v) = \begin{cases} u \parallel \text{":"} \parallel v & \text{if } u < v \\ v \parallel \text{":"} \parallel u & \text{if } v < u \end{cases}$$


For an ensemble of $N$ characters (yielding $\binom{N}{2} = \frac{N(N-1)}{2}$ channels; $6\text{ channels}$ for $N=4$: Bog, Spleen, Wart, Mum Grissel), the analyzer populates a symmetric matrix $\mathbf{M}$ ($\mathbf{M}[i, j] = \mathbf{M}[j, i], \; \mathbf{M}[i, i] = 0$):


$$\mathbf{M}_{\text{dyad}}[i, j] = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathbb{I}\Big( \{c_i, c_j\} \subseteq g.\text{participants\_primary} \Big)$$

#### 2. Three-Tier Participant Weighting & Institutional Dampeners

Naive analyzers fail by treating all character mentions identically. The engine differentiates three YAML participant arrays using distinct mathematical weights:

* **Primary Disputants (`participants_primary`, Weight $W_{\text{pri}} = 1.0$):** The two core stakeholders contesting personal stakes, Strings, and resentment in 2d6 duels.


* **Secondary Catalysts (`participants_can_involve`, Weight $W_{\text{sec}} = 0.25$):** Peripheral instigators or witnesses. The engine computes a secondary catalyst matrix:



$$\mathbf{M}_{\text{catalyst}}[u, v] = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathbb{I}\Big( (u \in g.\text{primary} \land v \in g.\text{secondary}) \lor (v \in g.\text{primary} \land u \in g.\text{secondary}) \Big)$$




A character with high primary counts but $\mathbf{M}_{\text{catalyst}} = 0$ is flagged as structurally isolated—incapable of acting as a chorus figure or meddler in third-party scenes.


* **Institutional Dampeners & Taboos (`participants_cannot_involve`, Weight $W_{\text{inh}} = -\infty$):** Cross-checked against the `goblin-spatial` co-location graph. If `char_mum_grissel` is listed in `participants_cannot_involve` for `watch_rotation_slack`, her physical presence in the hex room automatically suppresses that grievance from being drawn. Furthermore, Task 5 extends `participants_primary` to accept Faction/Cohort IDs so individual disputes can inherit factional subtext.



#### 3. Channel Health Classifications & Cooldown Lockout Math

Each channel $\mathbf{M}[u, v]$ is audited against `series.config.json` thresholds and rendered on the `GrievanceDAGViewer.tsx` heatmap:

* **`FATAL_BLIND_SPOT` ($\mathbf{M}[u, v] = 0$):** Rendered in **flashing red**; aborts compilation with Exit Code 1 at $T_0$. If $u$ and $v$ enter a room alone, $\mathcal{G}_{\text{eligible}} = \emptyset$, which would otherwise crash the Stage 3 lottery or force ungrounded LLM hallucination.


* **`FRAGILE_CHANNEL` ($\mathbf{M}[u, v] = 1$):** Rendered in **amber** (`DYADIC_FRAGILITY_WARNING`). When this sole grievance fires in Episode $E_k$, its frontmatter `cooldown_cycles: C` locks it in the database for $C$ episodes:



$$\text{Cooldown}(g, E) = \max\big(0, \, C - (E - E_k)\big)$$




For episodes $E_{k+1} \dots E_{k+C}$, $\mathbf{M}_{\text{active}}[u, v] = 0$, degrading the pair into a temporary blind spot.


* **`ROBUST_CHANNEL` ($\mathbf{M}[u, v] \ge 2$):** Rendered in **emerald green**, confirming healthy rotational variety across cooldowns.


* **`COOLDOWN_LOCKOUT_HAZARD`:** Highlighted in **red** at runtime when a robust or fragile channel has all of its authored grievances simultaneously suspended by active cooldown timers ($C_{\text{cycles}} > 0$), prompting the showrunner to manually promote a child node.

### 4. Cockpit Telemetry, Directorial Pinning & 2d6 Duel Simulation (`GrievanceDAGViewer.tsx`)

Mounted on `src/pages/telemetry/grievances.astro` (`client:idle`), `GrievanceDAGViewer.tsx` ingests the SSR-anchored `staticDAG` and subscribes to `worker-sower-engine` WebSocket/SSE streams (`ws://localhost:3000/events`) to overlay live simulation state onto the static three-column lattice ($\delta = 0 \to 1 \to 2$):

* **Live Node Overlays:** Displays progress bars for active intensity stages ($I_{\text{curr}} / I_{\max}$), episode cooldown badges ($C_{\text{cycles}}$), and animated **Atomic Promotion Pulses** along causal arrows whenever a Stage 4 duel triggers `spawns_on_max_escalation`.



#### The Anti-Boredom Steering Cycle & One-Click Scene Pinning

In normal autonomous operation, Stage 3a selects character pairs via proximity gating ($d(A, B) \le 1$), a **Boil-Over Override** (forcing an immediate confrontation if pairwise resentment $R(A, B) \ge 10$), and a weighted scoring heuristic:


$$W_{\text{pair}}(A, B) = \alpha \cdot \text{Tension}(A, B) + \beta \cdot \text{CyclesSinceInteraction}(A, B) - \gamma \cdot \text{RecentSceneCount}(A, B)$$


modulated by cast pairing entropy ($H_{\text{norm}} > 0.60$). However, when telemetry flags a starved dyad or a **Rolling Jaccard similarity $> 0.65$** across recent scenes, the showrunner intervenes via **One-Click Directorial Scene Pinning**.

Clicking **`[ PIN GRIEVANCE TO NEXT CYCLE ]`** on any dormant or un-spawned node (e.g., `grv_hoarding_reveal`) validates and dispatches a signed `DyadPinningIntent` (`goblin-dashboard/src/lib/schemas/directorPinning.ts`) over HTTP POST to `worker-sower-engine`:

```typescript
// goblin-dashboard/src/lib/schemas/directorPinning.ts
import { z } from 'zod';

export const DyadPinningIntentSchema = z.object({
  intent_id: z.string().uuid(),
  intent_type: z.literal('PIN_GRIEVANCE_OVERRIDE'),
  authorizer: z.literal('SHOWRUNNER'),
  target_cycle: z.number().int().positive(),
  payload: z.object({
    grievance_id: z.string().regex(/^grv_[a-z0-9_]+$/),
    forced_participants: z.tuple([
      z.string().regex(/^char_[a-z0-9_]+$/),
      z.string().regex(/^char_[a-z0-9_]+$/),
    ]),
    bypass_cooldown: z.boolean().default(true),
    forced_escalation_stage: z.number().int().min(1).max(5).optional(),
    mercy_resets: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  }),
  editorial_justification: z.string().min(10).max(500),
}).strict();

```

This intent obeys the **"Intents, Never Commands"** invariant: it bypasses the Stage 3 PRNG lottery, overrides active cooldown locks, and optionally applies **Directorial Narrative Release Valves** (`mercy_resets` to clear exhaustion/humiliation debuffs, forgive debt strings, or rotate Paranoia Clocks) while leaving all upstream somatic, spatial, and epistemic constraints intact. Every manual intervention is explicitly logged in the event ledger so that historical replayability ($S_{n+1} = \mathcal{R}(S_n, E_n, \sigma_n)$) remains 100% auditable.

#### Interactive 2d6 Duel Promotion Simulator

Before committing a pinned conflict to disk, the showrunner can click **`[ SIMULATE 2d6 DUEL PROMOTION ]`** inside `GrievanceDAGViewer.tsx` to dry-run Stage 4 mechanical resolution (`dual2d6.ts`) across the 1,296 discrete combinations of two opposed $2\text{d}6$ rolls ($D = X_1 - X_2 \in [-10, 10]$):


$$\text{Argument Score } (A) = (\text{Base} + \text{Roll}) + (\text{Strings Spent} \times W) - (\text{Debuffs} \times P)$$


where $\text{Base} \in [1, 5]$ (Spite, Cunning, or Charm), String Weight $W = 3$, and Penalty Weight $P = -2$ per condition. The simulator previews the exact ledger mutations across all canonical outcome branches:

1. **Clean Win ($\vert{}D\vert{} \ge 4$, $31.79\%$ base probability; $0$ Strings spent):** Complete victory; loser takes 1 condition (`humiliated`), winner receives clean validation.


2. **Costly Compromise / Win ($\vert{}D\vert{} = 3$, $16.05\%$ base; OR winner spent $\ge 2$ Strings):** Both participants take a condition; a third-party witness gains a leverage String on the winner.


3. **Mutual Escalation / Wound ($\vert{}D\vert{} \in \{1, 2\}$, $40.89\%$ base):** Both take emotional/physical trauma; active Paranoia Clock ticks forward. (Combined with True Ties, margins $\vert{}D\vert{} \le 2$ represent $52.16\%$ of unmodified rolls.)


4. **Catastrophic Backfire (Winner spent a String tied to an over-escalated, stale grievance):** Leverage inverts completely; nominal winner loses the String, takes `humiliated`, and nominal loser gains status.


5. **True Tie ($D = 0$, $11.27\%$ base) & Withdrawal:** Exact score equality gives both conditions and advances the Paranoia Clock by a full segment; if composure hits $0$ or an actor with `goes_silent` fails a Mutual Wound, a **Withdrawal** halves grievance cooldowns and applies `cowardice`.



#### Downstream Cache Invalidation (`sower why-dirty`) & The 10,000-Run Gauntlet

Because $\mathcal{G}_{\text{DAG}}$ is verified acyclic, any frontmatter edit to an upstream grievance triggers a finite, unidirectional invalidation sweep across the dependency graph at $T_0 = \$0.00$:


$$\text{SceneHash} = \mathcal{H}\left(\text{AST} + \sum_{i=1}^{k} \mathcal{H}(\text{Dependency}_i) + \text{Assets} + \text{CompilerVersion}\right)$$


Running `$ sower why-dirty grv_spoon_credit` traces `grv_spoon_credit` ($\delta=0$) $\to$ `grv_hoarding_reveal` ($\delta=1$) $\to$ `grv_generational_famine_feud` ($\delta=2$), flipping dependent scenes (`101/02`, `102/04`, `104/01`) to `IS_DIRTY = 1` without recursive invalidation storms. Furthermore, the entire DAG selection and duel loop is stress-tested pre-production via the **10,000-Encounter Monte Carlo Gauntlet**, asserting that all 6 dyads stay within $[8\%, 35\%]$ participation, Mutual Wounds land in $[45\%, 55\%]$, Clean Wins in $[12\%, 20\%]$, $\delta = 0 \to 1$ promotion occurs in $15\%\text{–}25\%$ of maxed duels, average Strings stay within $[0.5, 3.5]$, and boredom rejections remain $< 5\%$.

### 5. Deterministic Subtext Ratification & The Epistemic Attenuation Fence (`SceneReviewGate.tsx`)

Once a grievance duel resolves in Stage 4, it outputs a strict generative bounding box (participants, initial tension, required turns, mandatory physical exit conditions, and Dwight Swain MRU `VISCERAL_STING` 12-to-24 frame pre-speech reaction windows). To prevent the LLM from ruining the scene with generic, on-the-nose exposition—and to prevent human editors from breaking state continuity—the pipeline enforces **The Architectural Ratification Loop** over **The Forbidden Patch Loop**:

```text
❌ THE FORBIDDEN PATCH LOOP (Systemic Desynchronization)
Human line-edits generated screenplay text directly in NLE / editor
  ──► Engine no longer knows *why* the character spoke those words
  ──► Relational ledger & BeliefRecords desynchronize from media (Causality Drift)

✅ THE DETERMINISTIC ARCHITECTURAL RATIFICATION LOOP (Enforced at T_0 = $0.00)
Human flags defect: UNEARNED_RELEASE in SceneReviewGate.tsx (≤60s Triage Budget)
  ──► Interface extracts leaked lemma & appends to banned_attenuation_tokens mask
  ──► Clamps Subtext Suppression vector: S >= 0.85
  ──► Regenerates Minimal Enclosing Unit (MEU) AST patch at T_0 = $0.00
  ──► Appends structured diagnostic event to eval/rejections.jsonl
  ──► World ledger, event log, and dialogue_ast.json remain 100% unified

```

#### 1. Epistemic Horizon Auditing & Tactical Displacement Proxies

Before and during `SceneReviewGate.tsx` inspection, the dashboard’s **Epistemic Horizon Auditor** enforces the information delta $\Delta I = \mathcal{K}_{\text{audience}} \ominus \mathcal{K}_{\text{actor}}$ across four mechanisms:

* **Three-Column Horizon Split & Hearsay Decay:** Aligns **Audience Knowledge**, **Speaker Knowledge**, and **Interlocutor Knowledge** side-by-side, visualizing rumor propagation confidence via the exponential decay curve $\text{Confidence} = \text{Initial} \times (0.8)^h$ across $h$ hops.


* **Omniscience Breach Tripwire (`EPISTEMIC_FIREWALL_BREACH`):** Because the spatial engine (`goblin-spatial`) gates the epistemic engine (`horizon.ts`) via **Ignorance by Omission**, any fact a character did not physically perceive is scrubbed from their context window. If an actor's generated dialogue still utters a token belonging to an unwitnessed secret, the UI trips `EPISTEMIC_FIREWALL_BREACH` and highlights the offending line.


* **The Attenuation Fence & Tactical Displacement:** When a character holds a lethal secret or deep existential wound (*The Underneath*, e.g., failing grip strength or stolen solvent), the **Attenuation Engine** erects a "Negative Fence" of red-badged banned tokens (e.g., `["ration", "hoard", "food", "famine"]` or `["solvent", "poison", "steal"]`). The LLM is forced into a **Tactical Displacement Proxy**—negotiating existential terror entirely through aggressive arguments over brass siphon valve threading, silver spoon grease, corrugated iron culvert weight ratings, or agricultural diesel flash points.


* **Belief State Calibration:** Operators can directly adjust a character's subjective conviction slider (where $>5{,}000\text{ basis points}$ locks in a `False Belief` independent of objective truth) or force a topic into `WITHHELD` status to preserve dramatic irony.



#### 2. Closed-Taxonomy Subtext Ratification (`UNEARNED_RELEASE`)

`SceneReviewGate.tsx` adheres to three strict operational mandates: a **$\le 60\text{ s}$ temporal review budget**, **zero raw syntax trees** (plain-text operational summaries only), and **debugging output duality** (showing both the editorial script and the exact Stage 3/4 trace explaining why the grievance and outcome were drawn).

When an LLM draft slips past the initial prompt instructions and produces melodramatic confession or premature emotional resolution, the showrunner never edits the `.fountain` prose by hand. Instead, clicking the **`UNEARNED_RELEASE`** rejection tag triggers a five-step deterministic remediation cycle at $T_0 = \$0.00$:

1. **Lemma Extraction & Negative Fence Expansion:** The interface isolates the leaked emotional or thematic lemma from the rejected line and appends it directly to the scene's active token attenuation mask.


2. **Subtext Vector Clamping:** The scene's Subtext Suppression parameter is automatically clamped to $S \ge 0.85$, forcing the model back onto the grievance's *Surface Complaint* proxy.


3. **Minimal Enclosing Unit (MEU) AST Regeneration:** Rather than re-rolling the entire scene and risking canon drift, the engine regenerates only the affected beat's Minimal Enclosing Unit inside `dialogue_ast.json` at $T_0 = \$0.00$ (prior to spending a single cent on TTS synthesis or GPU video diffusion).


4. **Immutable Rejection Telemetry (`eval/rejections.jsonl`):** The rejection event, leaked token, and parameter delta are appended to `eval/rejections.jsonl` (and routed via structured JSON diagnostic tickets subject to the **Three-Cycle Escalation Rule**, which halts and escalates to a human Story Architect if an automated patch fails three consecutive times).


5. **The Human Ratification Boundary ($\text{Runtime Fact} \neq \text{Canonical Fact}$):** Once the regenerated subtext and somatic verb masks (`banned_kinetic_verbs`) pass inspection and the showrunner signs off, any emergent runtime details vetted from the `unratified_details` Harvest Queue cross the formal **Human Ratification Boundary**—stamping a Git commit with first-class causal provenance (`fact_id`, `event_id`, `episode_id`, `rule_version`, `approved_by`, `approved_at_revision`) and re-sealing `bible-state.json` ($H_{\text{root}}$).

#### Task 1.1: Dual-Rail Grievance Schema, Byte-0 Contract & 4-Outcome Cosine Gate

* **Primary Target Repository:** `astro-kahn-it-com/001.goblin-lore` (`packages/001.lore`).

* **Technical Subtasks & Implementation Nuance:**
1. Enforce the **Byte-0 Frontmatter Guarantee** across all `grievances/*.md` dossiers: files must open at byte 0 with `---` (zero UTF-8 BOM bytes or leading newlines) and use POSIX LF (`\n`, `0x0A`) line endings.


2. Define the strict Zod schema in `packages/001.lore/schemas/grievance.ts` separating the **Machine Rail** (frontmatter: `id` matching `/^grv_[a-z0-9_]+$/`, `category` across the 7 canonical thematic categories, `intensity_range` satisfying $1 \le I_{\min} \le I_{\max} \le \text{config.max\_grievance\_intensity}$, `cooldown_cycles`, `decay_rate`, three-tier participant arrays `participants_primary`, `participants_can_involve`, `participants_cannot_involve`, `required_props`, `location_tags`, `spawns_on_max_escalation`, and `resolution_paths`) from the **Voice Rail** (Markdown body sections: *Surface Complaint*, *The Underneath*, *Escalation Stages*, and *Callback Phrases*).


3. Enforce the **4-Outcome Structural Requirement** (`outcome_sketches` mapping `clean_win`, `costly_win`, `mutual_wound`, and `backfire` to non-empty strings) and assert in the Pass 1 linter that pairwise embedding cosine distance across all four sketches exceeds $0.25$.


4. Enforce the **Tonal Override Pool (Farce Contract)** when `tonal_override_eligible: true`: assert $I_{\max} \le 2$, `spawns_on_max_escalation` is empty (`[]`), the *Underneath* section explicitly declares *"There genuinely isn't an underneath; this is the point"*, and total farce files remain $\le 15\%$ of the corpus ($\text{Ratio}_{\text{tonal}} \le 0.15$).




* **Falsifiable Acceptance Criteria:** Pass 1 of `npx tsx scripts/compile.ts` exits with Code 1 at $T_0$ if any grievance violates Byte-0 formatting, sets $I_{\min} > I_{\max}$, exhibits outcome sketch cosine distance $\le 0.25$, or attaches child spawns to a farce node.



#### Task 1.2: Bidirectional DAG Ingestion, Three-Color DFS & Topological Solver ($\delta, \Pi_{\text{crit}}$)

* **Primary Target Repository:** `astro-kahn-it-com/001.goblin-lore` (`packages/001.lore/src/health/`).


* **Secondary / Interfacing Repositories:** `camp-candor/995.library` (Blessed HUD viewport integration).


* **Target File Manifest:** `packages/001.lore/src/health/dagGraphBuilder.ts`, `packages/001.lore/src/health/acyclicityVerifier.ts`, and `packages/001.lore/src/health/topologicalSolver.ts`.


* **Technical Subtasks & Implementation Nuance:**
1. Implement `buildEscalationGraph(grievances: Grievance[])` in `dagGraphBuilder.ts` to construct in-memory Forward Adjacency ($\text{Adj}[u] = \{v \mid (u \to v) \in \mathcal{E}_{\text{spawn}}\}$), Reverse Adjacency ($\text{RevAdj}[v] = \{u \mid (u \to v) \in \mathcal{E}_{\text{spawn}}\}$), an $O(1)$ node metadata registry, root set ($k_{\text{in}} = 0$), and terminal leaf set ($k_{\text{out}} = 0$), explicitly supporting convergent diamond topologies (e.g., `grv_silver_spoon_grease` and `grv_watch_rotation_slack` converging on `grv_generational_famine_feud`).


2. Implement the **Three-Color Depth-First Search (DFS)** in `acyclicityVerifier.ts` (`WHITE = 0`, `GRAY = 1`, `BLACK = 2`): if any outgoing edge targets a `GRAY` node on the active recursion stack, immediately abort traversal, unwind the parent-pointer backtrack stack, and emit `CYCLE_DETECTED` (`LORE_ESCALATION_CYCLE`) with the exact loop array (e.g., `["grv_rations", "grv_hoarding", "grv_rations"]`).


3. Implement memoized longest-path dynamic programming in `topologicalSolver.ts` once acyclicity is verified:



$$\delta(v) = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \text{RevAdj}[v] = \emptyset \\ 1 + \max_{u \in \text{RevAdj}[v]} \delta(u) & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$




Concurrently reconstruct the **Critical Pacing Path** $\Pi_{\text{crit}} = \langle v_0, v_1, \dots, v_{\delta_{\max}} \rangle$ and return a frozen `depthMap: Record<string, number>` and `maxDepth: number`.




* **Falsifiable Acceptance Criteria:** Cyclic test fixtures halt immediately with an exact cycle trace and zero stack-overflow exceptions, while diamond-convergent DAGs resolve exact integer depths ($\delta = 0 \to 1 \to 2$) and isolate $\Pi_{\text{crit}}$ deterministically.

In the Generative Production Pipeline, **Feature 1.2** bridges the fundamental chasm between **bottom-up procedural simulation** (where actors collide via 2d6 mechanics, spatial hex lattices, and grievance lotteries) and **top-down teleological closure** (where a multi-episode season must converge on a unified dramatic argument rather than wandering into endless soap-opera drift or pathological grudge loops).

Without this subsystem, an autonomous simulation engine (`worker-sower-engine`) operating purely on local push mechanics either drifts into passive *"And Then"* sequences or gets trapped in absorbing **Simulation Attractors** where characters repeat the same three arguments across fifty episodes. ### II. Task 1.2.1: "The Loom" Open Prophecy Schema & Just-In-Time Destiny (`LoreDO` & `ProphecyDO`)

In poorly designed narrative engines, a character is the "Chosen One" or the tragic victim because an intro script hardcoded their name, which immediately breaks if the actor stalls or takes an alternate path. Under **The Loom** architecture (Narrative Determinism and Just-In-Time Destiny), *destiny is not a name; it is a set of metadata tags—a "Job Opening" waiting for the right candidate to stumble into the interview and match the "Hash of Fate" at the exact millisecond*.

#### 1. The Open Prophecy Schema (`LoreDO`)

`LoreDO` stores a list of Open Prophecies structured as functional locks waiting for a state-derived key:

```json
{
  "id": "proph_breaker_of_chains",
  "text": "When the moon bleeds, one with a heart of iron shall shatter the throne.",
  "conditions": {
    "world_state": { "moon_phase": "BLOOD" },
    "player_tags": ["has_iron_heart_implant", "class_barbarian"],
    "location": "zone_throne_room"
  },
  "status": "UNFULFILLED",
  "reward_script": "event_shatter_throne"
}

```

* **The Fate Compiler Paradigm:** Tags act as variables, Prophecies act as functions, Actors act as arguments, and History is the return value. The system never writes the story directly; it writes the structural conditions for the story and lets autonomous actors crash into them.


* **The "Mark" System (Invisible Metadata Accumulation):** As actors move through the simulation acquiring injuries, debts, or inventory tokens, they accumulate invisible metadata tags. When an actor whose tag set satisfies `player_tags` enters the required `location` during the matching `world_state`, the prophecy awakens dynamically—making an emergent convergence feel as though it was scripted from Day 1.


* **The "False Prophet" Collision Trap & Highlander Singleton Logic:** Destiny is a global singleton resource. If multiple actors matching the required metadata tags enter the trigger zone simultaneously, the engine executes **Highlander Logic**:


1. It spawns a competitive confrontation (a race to the object or a direct duel: *"The Throne rejects the weak. Only one may strike"*).


2. The moment the event triggers for one candidate, the Prophecy state transitions atomically to `PENDING_COMPLETION`, locking out all other entities globally.


3. Upon resolution, `LoreDO` marks the record `FULFILLED_BY_<ACTOR_ID>`, `CampaignDirectorDO` shifts the macro-era, and the canonical library text is permanently updated with the actor's identity.





#### 2. `ProphecyDO` (Type #74): The Singleton of Doom & Aggregate Sin Clock

For Southern Gothic or tragic arcs where *"the ending is written before the curtain rises"* and *"every choice they made just greased the gears of their own destruction,"* the system deploys `ProphecyDO` (Type #74)—a global singleton (analogous to `EconomyDO`) that tracks a Doomsday Clock driven by aggregate sin rather than elapsed seconds:

```typescript
interface ProphecyState {
  current_era: "AGE_OF_ROT";
  doom_meter: number; // 0.0 to 1.0 (e.g., 0.74). At 1.0, the era collapses/resets.
  active_omens: ["OMEN_BLOOD_RAIN", "OMEN_DEAD_BIRDS"];
  triggers: {
    "sin_greed": 1000000; // Resource/Gold hoarded threshold
    "sin_wrath": 5000;    // Violence/Assault threshold
  };
}

```

* **Aggregate Noise Listening:** `ProphecyDO` subscribes to `AnalyticsDO`, ignoring isolated individual actions in favor of the cumulative weight of the ensemble's transgressions (hoarding, spite, violence).


* **Deterministic Startup Seeding & Branch Prediction:** Under the Deterministic-Sovereign mandate, the `ProphecyQueue` calculates future thresholds at startup via `Hash(Seed + RoomID + TimeBucket)`. Using Markov-chain branch prediction (`Next-Step Predictor`) and timeline forking (`Specter Mode`), the engine can project a "Bad Future" vision as a warning system; if the actors fail to satisfy the aversion condition, the vision becomes the literal map.


* **Obligation Locks (`TarotDO`):** When prophetic draws occur via seeded PRNG (`deck_seed`), drawn Fate Objects (`card: "THE_TOWER"`, `active_fates: Map<UserID, FateObject>`) are registered not as flavor text, but as mechanical **Obligations** that must be discharged in the ledger.

### III. Task 1.2.2: Prerequisite DAG Gravity & "The Prophet" Protocol (Discrete Graph Space)

In Cluster `01.canon` (`000.goblin-lore`), the narrative corpus is compiled into a strict Directed Acyclic Graph $\mathcal{G} = (\mathcal{V}, \mathcal{E})$ verified at compile time ($T_0 = \$0.00$), where vertices are partitioned into interpersonal grievances, unrevealed secrets, and world facts:


$$\mathcal{V} = \mathcal{G}_{\text{grievance}} \cup \mathcal{S}_{\text{secret}} \cup \mathcal{F}_{\text{fact}}$$

The graph enforces Trey Parker’s **"Therefore / But" Syntactic Invariant** across three tiers of **Topological Depth ($\delta$)** via `spawns_on_max_escalation` edges:

1. **Level 1 — Micro-Friction ($\delta = 0$):** Surface domestic disputes (e.g., `grv_spoon_credit`, bickering over who recovered a silver spoon).


2. **Level 2 — Meso-Progression ($\delta = 1$):** Reaching `intensity_ceiling` (Stage 4) on $\delta = 0$ spawns structural crises (e.g., `grv_hoarding_reveal`, exposing ration stockpiling).


3. **Level 3 — Terminal Thematic Attractor ($G_{\text{terminal}}, \delta \ge 2$):** Breaching the meso-conflict unlocks the foundational existential wound of the season (e.g., `sec_bog_famine_secret`).



#### The Physics of Causal Inversion (Hacking the Queue via the Phantom Tail)

At the start of a season, the catastrophic or climactic node $G_{\text{terminal}}$ sits dormant in the graph with an eligibility weight of `0.05 -> LOCKED` because it requires 100% of its prerequisite parent edges to be satisfied. To pull the autonomous simulation toward $G_{\text{terminal}}$ without rigging 2d6 dice rolls or letting an LLM invent plot turns, the engine deploys **The Prophet (Archetype 17 — Automated Teleological Injection Vector)**:

1. **Exploiting the "Phantom Tail":** In topological audits, nodes with in-degree zero or one ($k_{\text{in}} \le 1$)—props never contested, minor token moves, obscure axiom shifts, or peripheral territorial boundary shifts—normally represent "Dead Lore" (`THE PHANTOM TAIL`). However, high-magnitude climax nodes possess deep dependency trees anchored by dozens of these low-centrality, seemingly disconnected leaf prerequisites.


2. **Sub-Threshold Prerequisite Resolution:** The Prophet does not attack primary actors or attempt to force the climax directly. Instead, its backward-chaining algorithm traverses the Phantom Tail and methodically satisfies those benign, low-friction leaf conditions across early episodes.


3. **Probability Mass Inflation ($0.05 \to 0.99$):** Because the Stage 3 Grievance Lottery in `worker-sower-engine` selects active scenes according to the ratio of satisfied prerequisite edges:



$$P(G_k) = \frac{\sum_{e \in \text{Edges}(G_k)} w_e \cdot \mathbb{I}(e = \text{SATISFIED})}{\sum_{j} \text{Weight}(G_j)}$$



completing all secondary leaf dependencies exponentially inflates the probability mass of $G_{\text{terminal}}$, spiking its eligibility from `0.05` to `0.99` (`FORCED LOTTERY SELECTION`) and mathematically forcing the scheduler to select the climax.


4. **The Self-Fulfilling Epistemic Loop (Warping Secondary GOAP Heuristics):** Simultaneously, the reducer injects an authoritative `BeliefRecord` into the materialized state:


* `holder_id`: `"char_prophet"`

* `source_type`: `"PROPHECY"` or `"DIVINATION"`

* `subjective_probability`: `1.0` ($10{,}000\text{ bp}$)


* `proposition`: `"ASSERTION_EVENT_X_INEVITABLE"`


When secondary background agents ingest this $10{,}000\text{ bp}$ prediction via localized social diffusion, their Goal-Oriented Action Planning (GOAP) utility curves warp. Actors begin hedging and preparing for the predicted disaster—hoarding grain, abandoning fortifications, or liquidating scrap. **Their panic organically fulfills the remaining intermediate prerequisites of $G_{\text{terminal}}$**—achieving true causal inversion where declaring the outcome manufactures the exact somatic and logistical conditions required to produce it.




5. **Downstream Lexical Scaffolding Without Temporal Omniscience:** When the scene compiler formats prompt envelopes for the untrusted LLM, it injects structural omen tokens (`[ATMOSPHERE: TELEOLOGICAL_DREAD]`, `[RESONANCE: FATALISM]`) that bias attention heads toward foreboding sensory details (cracked foundations, dead birds, rust) while enforcing **Strict Epistemic Isolation**: characters are forbidden from citing future event IDs or uncommitted ledger states and may only speak in symbolic vectors grounded in the pending DAG branch.

### V. Task 1.2.4: The Registry of Deliberately Unresolved Canon & $T_0$ Compiler Tripwires

Because foundation models suffer from severe **narrative closure bias** (a statistical compulsion to explain every mystery and resolve every tension), pulling a season toward a Thematic Attractor risks having an LLM accidentally explain away the core existential mystery of the universe.

#### 1. The Epistemic Unresolved Canon Registry (`packages/001.lore/schemas/unresolved.schema.ts`)

To protect foundational ambiguity (`UNRESOLVED_BY_CANON`), the Architect registers permanent or long-arc mysteries (e.g., `mystery_the_famine`, `mystery_pantry_watcher`) in `schemas/ontology/unresolved.json` validated via Zod:

* **`topic_id`:** Globally unique namespaced identifier audited across Pass 1–3 compilation and AST checks.


* **`forbidden_propositions` & Multi-Lemma `trigger_lemma_sets`:** Because single-token bans (such as banning `"famine"`) cause false positives that block characters from discussing everyday hunger, the schema enforces **co-occurrence sets requiring at least two lemmas within shared syntactic proximity** (e.g., `["famine", "poisoned", "well"]` or `["watcher", "human", "child"]`).


* **`permitted_clue_tokens` & The Clue Disjointness Theorem:** Whitelisted sensory fragments (`["bitter_ash", "scratched_copper", "frost_burn"]`) that characters may reference without tripping an epistemic breach, governed by the compile-time assertion $\mathcal{P}_{\text{clues}} \cap \bigcup \mathcal{T}_{\text{lemmas}} = \emptyset$.


* **`epistemic_horizons` (`getEpistemicDirectives`):** A pure, deep-frozen projection lens that maps each character to `TOTAL_IGNORANCE` (scrubbing all related tokens from the prompt envelope) or `FALSE_BELIEF` (injecting a specific `distorted_belief` string such as *"Convinced the pantry elders secretly hoarded the grain sacks"* that the LLM must voice as subjective conviction without asserting as objective truth).


* **`human_promotion_condition` & The Monotonic Authority Principle:** Neither runtime 2d6 dice rolls nor derived dialogue ASTs can resolve an `UNRESOLVED_BY_CANON` mystery. A mystery can transition to `KNOWN_TRUE` if and only if:


1. The human showrunner verifies that the legal `human_promotion_condition` contract has been fulfilled.


2. A signed Git commit updates the canonical Markdown dossiers in `01.canon` (`series/`).


3. The resolution event is appended to the Tier 2 Event Log.


4. `compileLoreInstance` retires the entry from `unresolved.json` and reseals `bible-state.json` with a new cryptographic Merkle root ($H_{\text{root}}$).




* **Topological Reconsideration Cadence ($v_{\text{centrality}}$):** To prevent **The Sage (Archetype 16)** from exploiting unratified harvest-queue details via topological blackmail, and to manage long-term mysteries without calendar spam, the dashboard calculates topological weight:



$$v_{\text{centrality}} = \text{DaysSinceReconsideration} \times \log_{10}(\text{DownstreamDependentScenes} + 1)$$



Only mysteries sitting un-evaluated for $> 60$ days with high downstream scene dependencies are surfaced to ask *"Does preserving this unresolved mystery still serve the story?"*—where clicking **"Still Good"** updates `last_reconsidered_at` without bumping version hashes or invalidating caches.



#### 2. Architectural Defenses & Anti-Exploit Compiler Tripwires ($T_0 = \$0.00$)

To prevent automated Prophet vectors or Attractor gravity from locking the simulation into artificial queues or melodramatic collapse, the compiler enforces four hard tripwires:

1. **3-Color DFS Cycle Audit (`FATAL_CIRCULAR_CAUSALITY`):** During Pass 2 compilation in `scripts/compile.ts`, if any grievance or prophecy dependency creates a cycle ($A \to B \to A$), the build aborts with Exit Code 1.


2. **Prerequisite Gini Disruption Tripwire (`ARTIFICIAL_QUEUE_PUMPING`):** While global canon dispersion must stay within $0.30 \le G \le 0.50$ (locking out builds at $G > 0.65$ to prevent Monolithic Collapse), the runtime engine also monitors prerequisite completion velocity. If an isolated entity completes $> 80\%$ of a latent terminal node's dependencies within a compressed window without engaging primary conflict nodes, the system flags an `ARTIFICIAL_QUEUE_PUMPING` exploit.


3. **The Comedic Release Valve ($R_{\text{farce}}$ Invariant):** If Ontological Pressure ($\Phi$) around a prophesied climax reaches maximum saturation ($10{,}000\text{ bp}$) without organic somatic resolution, the engine trips the **Farce Invariant** ($R_{\text{farce}} \le 0.15$)—routing the pending apocalypse through an anticlimactic release valve (a clerical error, a missing key, or a mundane domestic misunderstanding) to vent pressure and preserve server homeostasis.


4. **Monotonic Time Ledger Invariant:** No prophetic mechanic or Attractor override can ever write an event to a future timestamp ($T > T_{\text{current}}$) in the append-only ledger; all teleological pull is restricted strictly to prerequisite edge weighting, `BeliefRecord` seeding, and modal boundary calibration.
